        artilleria: 'Artilharia', pelea: 'Briga', bajos_fondos: 'Submundo', borde_exterior: 'Orla Exterior', educacion: 'Educação',
        estrategia_militar: 'Estratégia militar', mundos_del_nucleo: 'Mundos do Núcleo', saber_arcaico: 'Conhecimento arcaico', xenologia: 'Xenologia',
    };
    function record(value) {
        return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : null;
    }
    function array(value) {
        return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
    }
    function text(value) {
        return typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
    }
    function integer(value) {
        return Number.isInteger(value) ? Number(value) : null;
    }
    function display(value) {
        const s = text(value);
        return s || '—';
    }
    function listText(value) {
        const direct = text(value);
        if (direct)
            return direct;
        const item = record(value);
        if (!item)
            return '';
        return text(item.text) || text(item.name) || text(item.type) || text(item.description);
    }
    function quantityMeta(value) {
        const q = integer(value.quantity);
        if (q === null)
            return undefined;
        if (q === 0)
            return 'Esgotado';
        return q > 1 ? `x${q}` : undefined;
    }
    function itemProjection(value) {
        const direct = text(value);
        if (direct)
            return { title: direct };
        const item = record(value);
        if (!item)
            return null;
        const title = text(item.name) || text(item.itemName) || text(item.title);
        if (!title)
            return null;
        return { title, meta: quantityMeta(item) };
    }
    const INVENTORY_CATEGORY_LABEL = {
        weapon: 'Arma', armor: 'Armadura', gear: 'Equipamento',
    };
    function explicitSourceMeta(item) {
        const catalogId = text(item.sourceCatalogId);
        if (catalogId)
            return `Catálogo auditado · ${catalogId}`;
        const source = record(item.source);
        if (!source)
            return null;
        const title = text(source.title) || text(source.name);
        const type = text(source.type);
        if (title && type)
            return `${title} · ${type}`;
        return title || type || null;
    }
    function inventoryItemProjection(value, category) {
        const direct = text(value);
        if (direct)
            return { title: direct, meta: INVENTORY_CATEGORY_LABEL[category] };
        const item = record(value);
        if (!item)
            return null;
        const title = text(item.name) || text(item.itemName) || text(item.title);
        if (!title)
            return null;
        const meta = [INVENTORY_CATEGORY_LABEL[category]];
        const quantity = integer(item.quantity);
        if (quantity !== null)
            meta.push(quantity === 0 ? 'Esgotado' : `Qtd. ${quantity}`);
        if (category === 'weapon') {
            const skill = text(item.skill);
            if (skill)
                meta.push(SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR[skill] ?? skill);
            const range = text(item.range);
            if (range)
                meta.push(`Alcance ${range}`);
            const damage = integer(item.damage);
            const damageBonus = integer(item.damageBonus);
            if (damage !== null)
                meta.push(`Dano ${damage}`);
            else if (damageBonus !== null)
                meta.push(`Dano Fortaleza ${damageBonus >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${damageBonus}`);
            const crit = integer(item.crit);
            if (crit !== null)
                meta.push(`Crítico ${crit}`);
            const qualities = array(item.qualities).map((entry) => text(entry)).filter(Boolean);
            if (qualities.length)
                meta.push(qualities.join(', '));
        }
        else if (category === 'armor') {
            const defense = integer(item.defense);
            const soak = integer(item.soak);
            if (defense !== null)
                meta.push(`Defesa ${defense}`);
            if (soak !== null)
                meta.push(`Proteção ${soak}`);
        }
        const source = explicitSourceMeta(item);
        if (source)
            meta.push(`Origem ${source}`);
        return { title, meta: meta.join(' · ') };
    }
    function projectCharacter(characterValue) {
        const c = record(characterValue);
        if (!c)
            return null;
        const derived = record(c.derived) ?? {};
        const wounds = record(derived.wounds) ?? {};
        const strain = record(derived.strain) ?? {};
        const xp = record(c.xp) ?? {};
        const specializations = array(c.specializations).map(listText).filter(Boolean);
        const motivations = array(c.motivations).map(listText).filter(Boolean);
        const obligations = array(c.obligations);
        const obligationTotal = obligations.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (integer(record(entry)?.value) ?? 0), 0);
        const obligationTypes = obligations.map(entry => text(record(entry)?.type)).filter(Boolean);
        const characteristics = Object.entries(record(c.characteristics) ?? {})
            .filter(([, value]) => Number.isInteger(value))
            .map(([key, value]) => ({ label: CHARACTERISTIC_LABELS_PT_BR[key] ?? key, value: String(value) }));
        const trainedSkills = Object.entries(record(c.skills) ?? {})
            .filter(([, value]) => Number.isInteger(value) && Number(value) > 0)
            .sort((a, b) => Number(b[1]) - Number(a[1]) || (SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR[a[0]] ?? a[0]).localeCompare(SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR[b[0]] ?? b[0], 'pt-BR'))
            .map(([key, value]) => ({ label: SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR[key] ?? key, value: String(value) }));
        const totalXp = integer(xp.total);
        const availableXp = integer(xp.available);
        const spentXp = totalXp !== null && availableXp !== null ? Math.max(0, totalXp - availableXp) : null;
        return {
            identity: [
                { label: 'Nome', value: display(c.name) },
                { label: 'Espécie', value: display(c.species) },
                { label: 'Carreira', value: display(c.profession) },
                { label: 'Especialização', value: specializations.join(' · ') || '—' },
            ],
            state: [
                { label: 'Ferimentos', value: integer(wounds.current) !== null && integer(wounds.threshold) !== null ? `${integer(wounds.current)}/${integer(wounds.threshold)}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Tensão', value: integer(strain.current) !== null && integer(strain.threshold) !== null ? `${integer(strain.current)}/${integer(strain.threshold)}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Obligation', value: obligations.length ? `${obligationTotal}${obligationTypes.length ? ` · ${obligationTypes.join(' · ')}` : ''}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Motivação', value: motivations.join(' · ') || '—' },
            ],
            characteristics,
            trainedSkills,
            progression: [
                { label: 'PE disponível', value: availableXp === null ? '—' : String(availableXp) },
                { label: 'PE gasto', value: spentXp === null ? '—' : String(spentXp) },
                { label: 'Escolhas elegíveis', value: '—' },
                { label: 'Histórico de progressão', value: '—' },
            ],
        };
    }
    function projectInventory(state, characterValue) {
        const c = record(characterValue);
        const master = record(state.master) ?? {};
        if (!c && !record(master.pendingAcquisition))
            return null;
        const owned = [];
        for (const [category, values] of [
            ['weapon', array(c?.weapons)],
            ['armor', array(c?.armor)],
            ['gear', array(c?.gear)],
        ]) {
            for (const value of values) {
                const item = inventoryItemProjection(value, category);
                if (item)
                    owned.push(item);
            }
        }
        const pendingRaw = record(master.pendingAcquisition);
        const pending = pendingRaw && (text(pendingRaw.itemName) || text(pendingRaw.itemId))
            ? {
                title: text(pendingRaw.itemName) || text(pendingRaw.itemId),
                meta: text(pendingRaw.status) === 'aguardando_mestre' ? 'Aguardando Mestre' : display(pendingRaw.status),
            }
            : null;
        return { credits: integer(c?.credits), owned, pending };
    }
    function defenseLabel(defenseValue) {
        const d = record(defenseValue);
        if (!d)
            return '—';
        const values = ['proa', 'babor', 'estribor', 'popa'].map((key) => integer(d[key]));
        return values.every((v) => v !== null) ? values.join(' / ') : '—';
    }
    function projectVehicle(state) {
        const runtime = record(state.vehicles);
        if (!runtime)
            return null;
        const activeId = text(runtime.activeVehicleId);
        const vehicles = record(runtime.vehicles) ?? {};
        const vehicle = activeId ? record(vehicles[activeId]) : null;
        if (!vehicle)
            return { active: false, name: null, summary: [], weapons: [], crew: [], criticalHits: [] };
        const speed = integer(vehicle.speed);
        const speedMax = integer(vehicle.speedMax);
        const hullDamage = integer(vehicle.hullDamage);
        const hullThreshold = integer(vehicle.hullThreshold);
        const systemStrain = integer(vehicle.systemStrain);
        const systemStrainThreshold = integer(vehicle.systemStrainThreshold);
        const weapons = array(vehicle.weapons).map(itemProjection).filter((v) => Boolean(v));
        const crew = array(vehicle.crew).map(itemProjection).filter((v) => Boolean(v));
        const criticalHits = array(vehicle.criticalHits).map((value, index) => {
            const hit = record(value);
            if (!hit)
                return null;
            return {
                title: text(hit.effect) || `Dano crítico ${index + 1}`,
                meta: hit.repaired === true ? 'Reparado' : 'Ativo',
            };
        }).filter((v) => Boolean(v));
        return {
            active: true,
            name: text(vehicle.shortName) || text(vehicle.name) || null,
            summary: [
                { label: 'Velocidade', value: speed !== null && speedMax !== null ? `${speed}/${speedMax}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Manejo', value: integer(vehicle.handling) === null ? '—' : String(integer(vehicle.handling)) },
                { label: 'Silhueta', value: integer(vehicle.silhouette) === null ? '—' : String(integer(vehicle.silhouette)) },
                { label: 'Blindagem', value: integer(vehicle.armor) === null ? '—' : String(integer(vehicle.armor)) },
                { label: 'Casco', value: hullDamage !== null && hullThreshold !== null ? `${hullDamage}/${hullThreshold}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Tensão de sistemas', value: systemStrain !== null && systemStrainThreshold !== null ? `${systemStrain}/${systemStrainThreshold}` : '—' },
                { label: 'Defesa', value: defenseLabel(vehicle.defense) },
                { label: 'Hiperimpulsor', value: vehicle.hyperdrive === true ? 'Sim' : vehicle.hyperdrive === false ? 'Não' : '—' },
            ],
            weapons,
            crew,
            criticalHits,
        };
    }
    function projectRecords(state) {
        const group = record(state.group) ?? {};
        const base = record(group.base) ?? {};
        const resources = array(group.resources).map(listText).filter(Boolean);
        const belongings = array(group.belongings).map(listText).filter(Boolean);
        const contacts = array(group.contacts).map(itemProjection).filter((v) => Boolean(v));
        const history = array(state.sessionHistory).map((value, index) => {
            const session = record(value);
            if (!session)
                return null;
            const number = integer(session.number) ?? index + 1;
            const summary = text(session.summary);
            return { title: `Sessão ${number}`, meta: summary || undefined };
        }).filter((v) => Boolean(v));
        return {
            // R21 não possui um campo canônico dedicado de objetivo da missão.
            mission: [],
            group: [
                { label: 'Base', value: display(base.name) },
                { label: 'Localização', value: display(base.location) },
                { label: 'Descrição', value: display(base.description) },
                { label: 'Obligation total', value: String(array(group.obligationEntries).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (Number(record(entry)?.value) || 0), 0)) },
                { label: 'Duty total', value: String(array(group.dutyEntries).reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (Number(record(entry)?.value) || 0), 0)) },
                { label: 'Contribuição', value: String(Number(group.contributionRank) || 0) },
                { label: 'Recursos', value: resources.join(' · ') || '—' },
                { label: 'Pertences', value: belongings.join(' · ') || '—' },
            ],
            contacts,
            history,
        };
    }
    function projectScene(state) {
        const scene = record(state.scene);
        const master = record(state.master) ?? {};
        if (!scene && !text(master.pendingQuestion))
            return null;
        return {
            title: text(scene?.title) || null,
            narration: text(scene?.narration) || null,
            question: text(master.pendingQuestion) || null,
        };
    }
    function projectReadyState(state) {
        const characterValue = record(state.player)?.character ?? null;
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            campaignName: text(state.name) || undefined,
            scene: projectScene(state),
            character: projectCharacter(characterValue),
            inventory: projectInventory(state, characterValue),
            vehicle: projectVehicle(state),
            records: projectRecords(state),
        };
    }
    function projectR21CampaignState(value) {
        const state = record(value);
        if (!state)
            return { ...exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL, status: 'unavailable', detail: 'Estado da campanha inválido.' };
        const schema = integer(state.schemaVersion);
        if (schema !== exports.R21_STATE_SCHEMA) {
            return { ...exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL, status: 'unsupported', detail: `Versão de estado não suportada pela interface: ${String(state.schemaVersion ?? 'desconhecida')}.` };
        }
        const player = record(state.player);
        const master = record(state.master);
        const vehicles = record(state.vehicles);
        const group = record(state.group);
        const combat = record(state.combat);
        const session = record(state.session);
        const world = record(state.world);
        const vehicleCombat = record(vehicles?.combat);
        const structurallyValid = Boolean(text(state.campaignId)
            && text(state.sessionId)
            && text(state.name)
            && text(state.rulesProfile)
            && player
            && master
            && vehicles
            && group
            && combat
            && session
            && world
            && vehicleCombat
            && typeof combat?.active === 'boolean'
            && typeof vehicleCombat?.active === 'boolean'
            && ['nao_iniciada', 'ativa', 'encerrada'].includes(text(session?.status))
            && Array.isArray(state.events)
            && Array.isArray(state.appliedActionIds)
            && Array.isArray(state.sessionHistory));
        if (!structurallyValid) {
            return { ...exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL, status: 'unavailable', detail: 'Estado da campanha incompleto ou corrompido.' };
        }
        return projectReadyState(state);
    }
    function readR21CampaignState(storage) {
        const source = storage ?? (typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.localStorage : null);
        if (!source)
            return exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL;
        let raw = null;
        try {
            raw = source.getItem(exports.R21_STORAGE_KEY);
        }
        catch {
            return { ...exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL, status: 'unavailable', detail: 'Não foi possível ler o estado local da campanha.' };
        }
        if (!raw)
            return exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL;
        try {
            return projectR21CampaignState(JSON.parse(raw));
        }
        catch {
            return { ...exports.EMPTY_R21_READ_MODEL, status: 'unavailable', detail: 'O estado local da campanha não pôde ser interpretado.' };
        }
    }

    function currentBridge() {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined')
            return undefined;
        return window.BraseiroGameBridge;
    }
    function isBridge(value) {
        return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.submitPlayerIntent === 'function';
    }
    function bridgeOrError() {
        const bridge = currentBridge();
        if (bridge === undefined)
            return { ok: false, error: 'BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'Motor Barbara indisponível neste ambiente.' };
        if (!isBridge(bridge))
            return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: 'Ponte do motor incompatível com esta shell.' };
        return bridge;
    }
    function normalizeResult(result, invalidMessage) {
        if (!result || typeof result !== 'object') {
            return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: invalidMessage };
        }
        const candidate = result;
        if (candidate.ok === true) {
            if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(candidate, 'data')) {
                return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: invalidMessage };
            }
            return { ok: true, data: candidate.data };
        }
        if (candidate.ok === false && typeof candidate.error === 'string' && candidate.error.trim() && typeof candidate.message === 'string' && candidate.message.trim()) {
            return { ok: false, error: candidate.error, message: candidate.message };
        }
        return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: invalidMessage };
    }
    function isRecord(value) {
        return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
    }
    function invalidPayload(message) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message };
    }
    function hasValidSnapshotId(value) {
        if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, 'snapshotId'))
            return false;
        const snapshotId = value.snapshotId;
        return snapshotId === null || (typeof snapshotId === 'string' && !!snapshotId.trim());
    }
    function validateFilePayloadResult(result, message) {
        if (!result.ok)
            return result;
        const data = result.data;
        if (!isRecord(data) || typeof data.fileName !== 'string' || !data.fileName.trim() || typeof data.json !== 'string' || !data.json.trim()) {
            return invalidPayload(message);
        }
        try {
            JSON.parse(data.json);
        }
        catch {
            return invalidPayload(message);
        }
        return { ok: true, data: { fileName: data.fileName, json: data.json } };
    }
    function validateCharacterMutationResult(result, message) {
        if (!result.ok)

        const data = result.data;
        if (!isRecord(data) || !isRecord(data.character) || !isRecord(data.state) || !hasValidSnapshotId(data))
            return invalidPayload(message);
        return result;
    }

        if (!result.ok)

        return result;
    }
    function validateSnapshotItemResult(result, message) {
        if (!result.ok)
            return result;
        const data = result.data;
        if (!isRecord(data))
            return invalidPayload(message);
        const id = typeof data.id === 'string' ? data.id.trim() : '';
        const label = typeof data.label === 'string' ? data.label.trim() : '';
        const createdAt = typeof data.createdAt === 'string' ? data.createdAt.trim() : '';
        if (!id || !label || !createdAt)

        return { ok: true, data: { id, label, createdAt } };
    }
    function validateRestoreResult(result, message) {

    function callOptional(method, args = []) {
        const bridge = bridgeOrError();
        if (!isBridge(bridge))
            return bridge;
        const fn = bridge[method];
        if (typeof fn !== 'function')
            return { ok: false, error: 'UNSUPPORTED', message: 'Esta capacidade exige uma versão compatível do Motor Barbara.' };
        try {
            return normalizeResult(fn.apply(bridge, args), 'Resposta inválida da ponte do motor.');
        }
        catch (error) {
            return { ok: false, error: 'ENGINE_REJECTED', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Falha no motor.') };
        }
    }
    function getBridgeAvailability() {
        const bridge = currentBridge();
        if (bridge === undefined)
            return 'unavailable';
        return isBridge(bridge) ? 'available' : 'invalid';
    }
    function getDataBridgeCapabilities() {
        const bridge = currentBridge();
        if (!isBridge(bridge))
            return { characterJson: false, campaignBackup: false, snapshots: false, randomCharacter: false };
        return {
            characterJson: typeof bridge.exportCharacterJson === 'function' && typeof bridge.importCharacterJson === 'function',
            campaignBackup: typeof bridge.exportCampaignBackup === 'function' && typeof bridge.importCampaignBackup === 'function',
            snapshots: typeof bridge.listSnapshots === 'function' && typeof bridge.createSnapshot === 'function' && typeof bridge.restoreSnapshot === 'function',
            randomCharacter: typeof bridge.generateRandomCharacter === 'function',
        };
    }
    async function submitPlayerIntentThroughBridge(text) {
        const intent = String(text ?? '').trim();
        if (!intent)
            return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Digite uma ação.' };
        const bridge = bridgeOrError();
        if (!isBridge(bridge))
            return bridge;
        try {
            return normalizeResult(await bridge.submitPlayerIntent(intent), 'Resposta inválida do canal do Mestre.');
        }
        catch (error) {
            return { ok: false, error: 'ENGINE_REJECTED', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error ?? 'Falha ao enviar a ação.') };
        }
    }

    function listSnapshotsThroughBridge() {

        if (!result.ok)

        if (!Array.isArray(result.data))

        for (const value of result.data) {
            if (!value || typeof value !== 'object')

    function downloadBridgeJson(payload) {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined')
            return { ok: false, error: 'UNSUPPORTED', message: 'Download indisponível neste ambiente.' };
        const value = payload;
        if (!value || typeof value.fileName !== 'string' || !value.fileName.trim() || typeof value.json !== 'string' || !value.json.trim()) {
            return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: 'Arquivo retornado pelo motor é inválido.' };
        }
        try {
            JSON.parse(value.json);
        }
        catch {
            return { ok: false, error: 'INVALID_BRIDGE', message: 'O motor retornou um arquivo que não contém JSON válido.' };
        }
        try {
            const blob = new Blob([value.json], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const anchor = document.createElement('a');
            anchor.href = url;
            anchor.download = value.fileName;
            document.body.appendChild(anchor);
            anchor.click();
            anchor.remove();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            return { ok: true, data: { fileName: value.fileName } };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return { ok: false, error: 'ENGINE_REJECTED', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Falha ao exportar arquivo.' };
        }
    }

    function renderQaState(props) {
        if (props.qaState === 'default' || props.qaState === 'demo')
            return null;
        const copy = {
            loading: { title: 'Carregando · estado de QA', body: 'Simulação visual de carregamento; não comprova sincronização, rede ou serviço externo real.', tone: 'soft' },
            skeleton: { title: 'Estrutura · estado de QA', body: 'Espaços reservados testam apenas a geometria; nenhum conteúdo ou carregamento real é afirmado.', tone: 'soft' },
            empty: { title: 'Vazio · estado de QA', body: 'Simulação visual de vazio; não afirma ausência real de dados da campanha.', tone: 'dark' },
            error: { title: 'Erro · estado de QA', body: 'Simulação visual de erro; não comprova falha real de carregamento, rede ou serviço.', tone: 'warning' },
            offline: { title: 'Offline · estado de QA', body: 'Este estado apenas testa a apresentação sem conexão; não comprova funcionamento offline real.', tone: 'warning' },
            partial: { title: 'Parcial · estado de QA', body: 'Simulação visual de dados incompletos; campos ausentes permanecem vazios e nenhum sincronismo é presumido.', tone: 'soft' },
        };
        const current = copy[props.qaState] ?? copy.empty;
        return ((0, jsx_runtime_1.jsxs)("div", { style: page, children: [(0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)(Header, { screen: props.screen, qaState: props.qaState }), (0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)(SiblingNav, { screen: props.screen, navigate: props.navigate }), (0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)(Card, { title: current.title, tone: current.tone, children: current.body })] }));
    }
    function renderTemplate(props) {
        const qa = renderQaState(props);
        if (qa)
            return qa;
        switch (props.screen.domain) {
            case 'Cena': return (0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)(SceneScreen, { ...props });
            case 'Personagem': return (0, jsx_runtime_1.jsx)(CharacterScreen, { ...props });

        scenePlayerView() {
            let state;
            try {
                state = this.repository.load();
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('STATE_READ_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
            if (!state)
                return fail('NO_CAMPAIGN', 'Nenhuma campanha carregada.');
            try {
                const world = state.world ?? {};
                const sceneLocationId = state.scene?.locationId ?? null;
                const locationCandidate = sceneLocationId ? world.locations?.[sceneLocationId] ?? null : null;
                const location = locationCandidate?.knownToPlayer
                    ? { id: locationCandidate.id, name: String(locationCandidate.name ?? ''), description: String(locationCandidate.description ?? '') }
                    : null;
                const participants = [];
                const seenParticipants = new Set();
                const sceneVisibleNpcIds = Array.isArray(state.scene?.visibleNpcIds) ? new Set(state.scene.visibleNpcIds.map(String)) : null;
                const sceneNarrativeText = String(state.scene?.narration ?? state.master?.narration ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR');
                const pushParticipant = (value) => {
                    const name = String(value?.name ?? '').trim();
                    const identityKey = value?.id ? `id:${String(value.id)}` : `name:${name.toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR')}`;
                    if (!name || seenParticipants.has(identityKey) || participants.length >= 3)
                        return;
                    seenParticipants.add(identityKey);
                    participants.push({
                        id: value?.id ? String(value.id) : null,
                        kind: String(value?.kind ?? 'npc'),
                        tokenEligible: value?.tokenEligible !== false && Boolean(value?.id),
                        name,
                        meta: String(value?.meta ?? '').trim(),
                        status: String(value?.status ?? '').trim(),
                        species: String(value?.species ?? '').trim(),
                        sex: String(value?.sex ?? '').trim(),
                        gender: String(value?.gender ?? '').trim(),
                        origin: String(value?.origin ?? '').trim(),
                        career: String(value?.career ?? '').trim(),
                        specialization: String(value?.specialization ?? '').trim(),
                        occupation: String(value?.occupation ?? '').trim(),
                        ageYears: Number.isFinite(Number(value?.ageYears)) ? Math.trunc(Number(value.ageYears)) : null,
                        appearance: String(value?.appearance ?? '').trim(),
                        visualFacts: Array.isArray(value?.visualFacts) ? value.visualFacts.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8) : [],
                        visualTags: Array.isArray(value?.visualTags) ? value.visualTags.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12) : [],
                    });
                };
                for (const npc of Object.values(world.npcs ?? {})) {
                    if (!npc?.knownToPlayer)
                        continue;
                    if (sceneVisibleNpcIds?.size) {
                        if (!sceneVisibleNpcIds.has(String(npc.id)))
                            continue;
                    }
                    else {
                        if (!sceneNarrativeText)
                            continue;
                        const needle = String(npc.name ?? '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR');
                        if (!needle || !sceneNarrativeText.includes(needle))
                            continue;
                    }
                    if (sceneLocationId && npc.locationId && npc.locationId !== sceneLocationId)
                        continue;
                    pushParticipant({
                        id: npc.id,
                        kind: 'npc',
                        name: npc.name,
                        meta: npc.relation || 'Conhecido',
                        status: npc.status || '',
                        species: npc.species || '', sex: npc.sex || '', gender: npc.gender || '', origin: npc.origin || '', career: npc.career || '', specialization: npc.specialization || '', occupation: npc.occupation || '', ageYears: npc.ageYears ?? null, appearance: npc.appearance || '',
                        visualFacts: (npc.facts ?? []).filter(f => f?.knownToPlayer).map(f => f.text),
                        visualTags: npc.tags ?? [],
                    });
                }
                if (state.combat?.active) {
                    for (const adversary of state.combat.adversaries ?? []) {
                        pushParticipant({
                            id: adversary.id ? `combat:${adversary.id}` : null,
                            kind: 'adversary',
                            name: adversary.name || adversary.id,
                            meta: 'Em confronto',
                            status: adversary.status || '',
                            visualFacts: Array.isArray(adversary.facts) ? adversary.facts.map(f => typeof f === 'string' ? f : f?.text).filter(Boolean) : [],
                            visualTags: Array.isArray(adversary.tags) ? adversary.tags : [],
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (state.vehicles?.combat?.active) {
                    const targetId = state.vehicles.combat.targetVehicleId;
                    const target = targetId ? state.vehicles.vehicles?.[targetId] ?? null : null;
                    if (target)
                        pushParticipant({ id: target.id ? `vehicle:${target.id}` : null, kind: 'vehicle', tokenEligible: false, name: target.name, meta: 'Veículo / nave alvo', status: 'Em confronto' });
                }
                const activeVehicleId = state.vehicles?.activeVehicleId ?? null;
                const activeVehicle = activeVehicleId ? state.vehicles?.vehicles?.[activeVehicleId] ?? null : null;
                const defense = activeVehicle?.defense ?? null;
                const vehicle = activeVehicle ? {
                    name: String(activeVehicle.name ?? ''),
                    hull: `${Number(activeVehicle.hullDamage ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.hullThreshold ?? 0)}`,
                    strain: `${Number(activeVehicle.systemStrain ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.systemStrainThreshold ?? 0)}`,
                    speed: `${Number(activeVehicle.speed ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.speedMax ?? 0)}`,
                    defense: defense ? `P${Number(defense.proa ?? 0)} · B${Number(defense.babor ?? 0)} · E${Number(defense.estribor ?? 0)} · R${Number(defense.popa ?? 0)}` : '—',
                } : null;
                let situation = '';
                const pendingQuestion = String(state.master?.pendingQuestion ?? '').trim();
                const pendingCheck = state.master?.suggestedCheck ?? null;
                if (pendingQuestion) {
                    situation = pendingQuestion;
                }
                else if (pendingCheck?.reason) {
                    situation = String(pendingCheck.reason).trim();
                }
                else if (state.vehicles?.combat?.active) {
                    situation = 'A nave está sob pressão. Escolha o próximo movimento.';
                }
                else if (state.combat?.active) {
                    situation = 'O confronto está aberto. Escolha sua próxima ação.';
                }
                else if (state.session?.status === 'ativa') {
                    situation = 'Escolha uma das ações abaixo ou descreva outra ação ao Mestre.';
                }
                else {
                    situation = 'Inicie a sessão para receber a próxima decisão do Mestre.';
                }
                const sceneVisual = sceneLibrary_mjs_1.resolveSceneVisualForState(state);
                return ok({
                    scene: { title: String(state.scene?.title ?? ''), location, imageAssetId: sceneVisual.asset?.assetId ?? null, imageSource: sceneVisual.source, image: sceneVisual.descriptor, imageFallback: sceneVisual.asset ? null : 'gemini' },
                    situation: String(situation).slice(0, 900),
                    participants,
                    suggestedActions: Array.isArray(state.master?.suggestedActions) ? state.master.suggestedActions.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6) : [],
                    suggestedCheck: state.master?.suggestedCheck ? clone(state.master.suggestedCheck) : null,
                    vehicle,
                    session: state.session ? { status: state.session.status, phase: state.session.phase, number: state.session.number } : null,
                    lastCheck: state.lastCheck ? clone(state.lastCheck) : null,
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('PLAYER_VIEW_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

                return fail('NO_CAMPAIGN', 'Nenhuma campanha carregada.');

            }
        }
        exportCharacterJson() {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            try {
                const game = controllerResult.data;
                const json = game.exportCharacter();
                const name = String(game.state.player?.character?.name ?? 'personagem').trim() || 'personagem';
                const safeName = name.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'personagem';
                return ok({ fileName: `${safeName}.json`, json });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CHARACTER_EXPORT_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

            }
        }

        creationCatalog(origin = null) {
            try {
                const state = this.repository.load();
                const mode = String(state?.campaignMode ?? 'EOTE').toUpperCase();
                const requestedOrigin = String(origin ?? (mode === 'AOR' ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE')).toUpperCase();
                const useAor = mode === 'AOR' || (mode === 'MIXED' && requestedOrigin === 'AOR');
                const speciesSource = useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.AOR_SPECIES : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.EOTE_SPECIES;
                const careerSource = useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.AOR_CAREERS : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.EOTE_CAREERS;
                const species = Object.entries(speciesSource).map(([key, value]) => ({
                    key,
                    label: value.label,
                    characteristics: clone(value.characteristics),
                    woundBase: value.woundBase,
                    strainBase: value.strainBase,
                    xp: value.xp,
                    careerFreeCount: value.careerFreeCount ?? 4,
                    specializationFreeCount: value.specFreeCount ?? 2,
                    freeSkill: value.freeSkill ? clone(value.freeSkill) : null,
                    freeTalents: clone(value.freeTalents ?? []),
                    speciesChoice: value.speciesChoice ? clone(value.speciesChoice) : null,
                    abilities: clone(value.abilities ?? []),
                }));
                const careers = Object.entries(careerSource).map(([key, value]) => ({
                    key,
                    label: value.label,
                    skills: clone(value.skills),
                    specializations: Object.entries(value.specializations ?? {}).map(([specializationKey, specialization]) => ({ key: specializationKey, label: specialization.label, skills: clone(specialization.skills) })),
                }));
                return ok({
                    profile: 'EOTE_CORE',
                    activeProfile: useAor ? 'AOR_CORE' : 'EOTE_CORE',
                    campaignMode: mode,
                    creationOrigin: useAor ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE',
                    species,
                    careers,
                    obligationTypes: clone(useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.DUTY_TYPES_PT_BR : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR),
                    characteristicLabels: clone(labelsPtBr_mjs_1.CHARACTERISTIC_LABELS_PT_BR),
                    skillLabels: clone(labelsPtBr_mjs_1.SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR),
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CREATION_CATALOG_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

                return ok({
                    xpBudget: preview.xpBudget, characteristicCost: preview.characteristicCost, xpRemaining: preview.xpRemaining, credits: preview.credits,
                    obligation: preview.duty, startingObligation: preview.duty + preview.dutySpent, additionalObligation: -preview.dutySpent,
                    obligationOfficial: preview.dutyOfficial, obligationNote: preview.dutyNote ?? null, speciesXpBonus: 0,
                    activeProfile: 'AOR_CORE', duty: preview.duty, dutySpent: preview.dutySpent
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CREATION_PREVIEW_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
        createCustomCharacter(options = {}, { createSnapshot = true } = {}) {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            const game = controllerResult.data;
            let snapshotId = null;
            try {
                const mode = String(game.state.campaignMode ?? 'EOTE').toUpperCase();
                const requestedOrigin = String(options?.creationOrigin ?? (mode === 'AOR' ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE')).toUpperCase();
                const useAor = mode === 'AOR' || (mode === 'MIXED' && requestedOrigin === 'AOR');
                let mapped = null;
                if (useAor) {
                    mapped = { ...clone(options), dutyType: options.obligationType, dutyReductions: clone(options.obligationBenefits ?? {}) };
                    characterCreation_mjs_1.createAorCoreCharacter(mapped);
                }
                else {
                    eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.createEoteCoreCharacter(options);
                }
                if (createSnapshot && game.state.player?.character)
                    snapshotId = this.snapshots.create(game.state, 'Antes de criar ficha manual').id;
                const created = useAor ? game.createAorCharacter(mapped) : game.createCustomCharacter(options);
                return ok({ character: clone(created), snapshotId, state: clone(game.state) });
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (snapshotId) {
                    try {
                        this.snapshots.remove(snapshotId);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return fail('CUSTOM_CHARACTER_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

        commitForce(effectId, count = 1) {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)

                    groups.push(...imageLibrary_mjs_1.searchImageAssets(imageLibraryData_mjs_1.IMAGE_LIBRARY_MANIFEST, { ...common, category: 'creature', subtype: 'beast', limit: 500 }));

        async submitPlayerIntent(text, { fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 60000, signal = null } = {}) {
            const intentText = String(text ?? '').trim();
            if (!intentText)
                return fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'Digite uma ação.');
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            const game = controllerResult.data;
            try {
                // Provider HTTP explícito continua sendo autoridade quando configurado.
                if (game.state.settings?.masterProvider === 'http') {
                    const result = await game.requestMasterTurn({
                        intentText,
                        endpoint: game.state.settings.masterEndpoint,
                        fetchImpl,
                        timeoutMs,
                        signal,
                    });
                    return ok({ mode: 'http', result: clone(result), state: clone(game.state) });
                }
                // No Android final, Gemini é o narrador padrão quando a chave está configurada.
                // A mutação continua passando exclusivamente por requestMasterTurn/validateMasterProposal.
                const native = nativeGeminiStatus(globalThis);
                if (native.available && native.configured) {
                    if (game.state.player?.character && game.state.session?.status !== 'ativa')
                        game.startSession();
                    const nativeFetch = async (_url, init = {}) => {
                        let providerPayload;
                        try {
                            providerPayload = JSON.parse(String(init.body ?? '{}'));
                        }
                        catch {
                            throw new Error('Contexto serializado do Motor Barbara inválido.');
                        }
                        const remote = await requestNativeGeminiMaster(providerPayload, { timeoutMs, target: globalThis });
                        const allowedRuleIds = new Set((providerPayload?.context?.rules ?? []).map(rule => String(rule?.id ?? '')).filter(Boolean));
                        const proposal = clone(remote.proposal ?? {});
                        if (Array.isArray(proposal.sourceRuleIds)) {
                            proposal.sourceRuleIds = proposal.sourceRuleIds.map(String).filter(id => allowedRuleIds.has(id));
                        }
                        return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ proposal, meta: { provider: 'gemini-native', model: remote.model ?? native.model ?? null } }) };
                    };
                    const result = await game.requestMasterTurn({
                        intentText,
                        endpoint: 'https://braseiro.native/master',
                        fetchImpl: nativeFetch,
                        timeoutMs,
                        signal,
                    });
                    return ok({ mode: 'gemini-native', result: clone(result), state: clone(game.state) });
                }
                // Fallback local deliberadamente não inventa prosa: registra a intenção, consulta o
                // contexto/regras canônicas e mantém a campanha utilizável mesmo sem rede/chave.
                const result = game.submitIntent(intentText);
                return ok({
                    mode: 'local',
                    result: clone(result),
                    state: clone(game.state),
                    masterNotice: native.available && !native.configured
                        ? 'Configure a chave Gemini em AJUSTES → Gemini / provedor para habilitar a narração automática.'
                        : 'Narrador remoto indisponível; o Motor Barbara local preservou estado e contexto de regras.',
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('ENGINE_REJECTED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
    }
    exports.BraseiroUiBridge = BraseiroUiBridge;
    function createBraseiroUiBridge(options = {}) {
        return new BraseiroUiBridge(options);
    }
    function installBraseiroUiBridge(target = globalThis, options = {}) {
        if (!target || (typeof target !== 'object' && typeof target !== 'function'))
            throw new Error('Alvo global inválido para a ponte de UI.');
        if (target.BraseiroGameBridge)
            return target.BraseiroGameBridge;
        const bridge = createBraseiroUiBridge(options);
        Object.defineProperty(target, 'BraseiroGameBridge', {
            value: bridge,
            configurable: false,
            enumerable: false,
            writable: false,
        });
        return bridge;
    }

                const npc = world_mjs_1.createNpc(op);
                next = world_mjs_1.upsertNpc(next, npc);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: npc.id });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'move_npc') {
                if (op.locationId && !next.locations?.[op.locationId])
                    throw new Error(`Local não encontrado: ${op.locationId}`);
                next = world_mjs_1.moveNpc(next, op.npcId, op.locationId);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_npc_faction') {
                if (op.factionId && !next.factions?.[op.factionId])
                    throw new Error(`Facção não encontrada: ${op.factionId}`);
                next = world_mjs_1.setNpcFaction(next, op.npcId, op.factionId);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_npc_goal') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setNpcGoal(next, op.npcId, op.goal);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_npc_relation') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setNpcRelation(next, op.npcId, op.relation);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_npc_status') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setNpcStatus(next, op.npcId, op.status);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_npc_visibility') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setNpcVisibility(next, op.npcId, op.knownToPlayer);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'record_npc_fact') {
                next = world_mjs_1.recordNpcFact(next, op.npcId, { text: op.text, knownToPlayer: op.knownToPlayer });
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.npcId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_faction_objective') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setFactionObjective(next, op.factionId, op.objective);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_faction_status') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setFactionStatus(next, op.factionId, op.status);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'add_faction_resource') {
                next = world_mjs_1.addFactionResource(next, op.factionId, op.resource);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'remove_faction_resource') {
                next = world_mjs_1.removeFactionResource(next, op.factionId, op.resource);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_faction_relation') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setFactionRelation(next, op.factionId, op.targetFactionId, op.relation);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'record_faction_fact') {
                next = world_mjs_1.recordFactionFact(next, op.factionId, { text: op.text, knownToPlayer: op.knownToPlayer });
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'create_faction_plan') {
                const result = world_mjs_1.createFactionPlan(next, op.factionId, { title: op.title, objective: op.objective, steps: op.steps, knownToPlayer: op.knownToPlayer });
                next = result.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: result.plan.id, factionId: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_faction_plan_status') {
                next = world_mjs_1.setFactionPlanStatus(next, op.factionId, op.planId, op.status);
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.planId, factionId: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'advance_faction_plan') {
                const result = world_mjs_1.advanceFactionPlan(next, op.factionId, op.planId);
                next = result.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.planId, factionId: op.factionId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'schedule_event') {
                const scheduled = world_mjs_1.scheduleWorldEvent(next, { type: op.eventType, dueTick: op.dueTick, payload: op.payload, dedupeKey: op.dedupeKey });
                next = scheduled.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: scheduled.event.id, created: scheduled.created });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'resolve_hook') {
                next = world_mjs_1.resolveWorldHook(next, op.hookId, { resolution: op.resolution, dismiss: op.dismiss });
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.hookId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'close_aftermath') {
                next = world_mjs_1.closeWorldAftermath(next, op.aftermathId, { resolution: op.resolution });
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.aftermathId });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'create_opportunity') {
                const result = sandbox_mjs_1.createOpportunity(next, op);
                next = result.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: result.opportunity.id });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_opportunity_status') {
                const result = sandbox_mjs_1.setOpportunityStatus(next, op.opportunityId, op.status, { resolution: op.resolution });
                next = result.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.opportunityId, status: result.opportunity.status });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'advance_clock') {
                const result = sandbox_mjs_1.advanceWorldClock(next, op.clockId, { steps: op.steps });
                next = result.world;
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.clockId, progress: result.clock.progress });
            }
            else if (op.type === 'set_market') {
                next = sandbox_mjs_1.setMarketProfile(next, op.locationId, { rarityModifier: op.rarityModifier, restrictedAccess: op.restrictedAccess, tags: op.tags, notes: op.notes });
                applied.push({ type: op.type, id: op.locationId });
            }
            else
                throw new Error(`Operação de mundo não suportada: ${op.type}`);
        }
        return { world: next, applied };
    }
    function initiativeSkillKey(value) {
        if (!['frialdad', 'alerta'].includes(value))
            throw new Error('A iniciativa deve usar Frieza ou Alerta.');
        return value;
    }
    function difficultyWithUpgrades(difficulty, challenge, upgrades) {
        let d = Math.max(0, Number(difficulty) || 0);
        let c = Math.max(0, Number(challenge) || 0);
        let n = Math.max(0, Number(upgrades) || 0);
        while (n-- > 0) {
            if (d > 0) {
                d -= 1;
                c += 1;
            }
            else
                d += 1;
        }
        return { difficulty: d, challenge: c };
    }
    function defenseSetback(character, weapon) {
        const melee = weapon?.skill === 'pelea' || weapon?.skill === 'armas_cuerpo_a_cuerpo';
        return Number(character?.derived?.defense?.[melee ? 'melee' : 'ranged'] ?? 0);
    }
    function chooseNpcWeapon(adversary) {
        for (const weapon of adversary.weapons ?? []) {
            try {
                attackDifficulty_mjs_1.attackDifficultyForWeapon(weapon, adversary.range);
                return weapon;
            }
            catch { }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function clone(value) { return structuredClone(value); }
    function applyEconomicProposal(state, proposal) {
        let next = structuredClone(state);
        if (proposal.acquisitionRequest) {
            if (next.master?.pendingAcquisition)
                throw new Error('Já existe uma aquisição aguardando resolução.');
            const market = sandbox_mjs_1.marketProfile(next.world, next.scene?.locationId ?? null);
            const pending = economy_mjs_1.createPendingAcquisition(proposal.acquisitionRequest.kind, proposal.acquisitionRequest.itemId, requireCharacter(next.player?.character), {
                requestId: ids_mjs_1.newId('acq'), locationId: next.scene?.locationId ?? null, market
            });
            next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('acqreq'), type: 'EQUIPMENT_ACQUISITION_PENDING', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { pending } });
        }
        if (proposal.acquisitionDecision) {
            const resolved = economy_mjs_1.resolvePendingAcquisition(next, next.master?.pendingAcquisition, { ...proposal.acquisitionDecision, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            next = resolved.state;
            next.master = { ...(next.master ?? {}), pendingAcquisition: null, acquisitionHistory: [...(next.master?.acquisitionHistory ?? []), structuredClone(resolved.record)] };
            next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('acq'), type: 'ECONOMY_TRANSACTION', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { record: resolved.record } });
        }
        for (const op of proposal.economyOperations ?? []) {
            let result;
            if (op.type === 'grant_asset')
                result = economy_mjs_1.grantCatalogAsset(next, { ...op, locationId: next.scene?.locationId ?? null, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            else if (op.type === 'lose_asset')
                result = economy_mjs_1.loseOwnedAsset(next, op.assetId, { ...op, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            else if (op.type === 'damage_asset')
                result = economy_mjs_1.damageOwnedAsset(next, op.assetId, { ...op, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            else if (op.type === 'repair_asset')
                result = economy_mjs_1.repairOwnedAsset(next, op.assetId, { ...op, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            else if (op.type === 'sell_asset')
                result = economy_mjs_1.sellOwnedAsset(next, op.assetId, { ...op, sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds });
            else
                throw new Error(`Operação econômica não suportada: ${op.type}`);
            next = result.state;
            next.master = { ...(next.master ?? {}), acquisitionHistory: [...(next.master?.acquisitionHistory ?? []), structuredClone(result.record)] };
            next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('econ'), type: 'ECONOMY_TRANSACTION', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { record: result.record } });
        }
        return next;
    }
    function validateEncounterDirectiveAgainstState(state, directive) {
        if (!directive)
            return null;
        if (state.combat?.active)
            throw new Error('Não é possível preparar outro encontro durante um combate ativo.');
        if (directive.sourceHookId) {
            const hook = state.world?.hooks?.find(h => h.id === directive.sourceHookId);
            if (!hook || hook.status !== 'pending')
                throw new Error('A consequência causal indicada não está mais pendente.');
            if (hook.locationId && state.scene?.locationId && hook.locationId !== state.scene.locationId)
                throw new Error('A consequência causal indicada pertence a outro local da cena.');
        }
        const seen = new Set();
        for (const spec of directive.adversaries ?? []) {
            if (spec.factionId && !state.world?.factions?.[spec.factionId])
                throw new Error(`Facção do adversário não encontrada: ${spec.factionId}`);
            if (!spec.worldNpcId)
                continue;
            if (seen.has(spec.worldNpcId))
                throw new Error('O mesmo PNPC persistente não pode ocupar dois grupos no encontro.');
            seen.add(spec.worldNpcId);
            const npc = state.world?.npcs?.[spec.worldNpcId];
            if (!npc)
                throw new Error(`PNPC persistente não encontrado: ${spec.worldNpcId}`);
            if (npc.combatState?.profileKey && npc.combatState.profileKey !== spec.profileKey)
                throw new Error('O perfil de combate do PNPC persistente não pode mudar silenciosamente.');
            if (npc.combatState?.status === 'incapacitated')
                throw new Error(`${npc.name} está incapacitado e não pode iniciar outro encontro.`);
            if (spec.factionId && npc.factionId && spec.factionId !== npc.factionId)
                throw new Error('A facção do PNPC persistente não pode mudar silenciosamente no encontro.');
        }
        return directive;
    }
    class GameController {
        constructor(repository) {
            this.repository = repository;
            this.state = repository.load() ?? state_mjs_1.createCampaign('Rebelião - campanha local');
            repository.save(this.state);
        }
        commit(type, payload) {
            this.state = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(this.state, {
                id: ids_mjs_1.newId('evt'), type, at: new Date().toISOString(), payload
            });
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return this.state;
        }
        newCampaign(name) {
            this.state = state_mjs_1.createCampaign(name?.trim() || 'Nova campanha');
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return this.state;
        }
        restartSandboxPreservingParty() {
            const previous = this.state;
            const next = state_mjs_1.createCampaign(previous?.name?.trim() || 'Nova campanha');
            next.campaignMode = previous?.campaignMode ?? next.campaignMode;
            next.player = structuredClone(previous?.player ?? next.player);
            next.group = structuredClone(previous?.group ?? next.group);
            next.vehicles = structuredClone(previous?.vehicles ?? next.vehicles);
            next.settings = structuredClone(previous?.settings ?? next.settings);
            this.state = next;
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return {
                state: this.state,
                preserved: {
                    character: Boolean(this.state.player?.character),
                    group: true,
                    vehicles: true,
                    settings: true,
                    campaignMode: this.state.campaignMode
                }
            };
        }
        setCampaignMode(mode = 'EOTE') {
            const value = String(mode ?? '').trim().toUpperCase();
            if (!['EOTE', 'AOR', 'MIXED'].includes(value))
                throw new Error('Modo de campanha deve ser EOTE, AOR ou MIXED.');
            this.commit('CAMPAIGN_MODE_UPDATED', { campaignMode: value });
            return { campaignMode: this.state.campaignMode, obligationActive: modeAllowsObligation(this.state), dutyActive: modeAllowsDuty(this.state) };
        }
        campaignModeSummary() {
            return { campaignMode: campaignMode(this.state), rulesProfile: this.state.rulesProfile, obligationActive: modeAllowsObligation(this.state), dutyActive: modeAllowsDuty(this.state) };
        }
        startSession({ playerCount = 1, destinyPlayerCount = null, rng = Math.random, obligationRoll = null, dutyRoll = null } = {}) {
            let character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            if (this.state.combat?.active)
                throw new Error('Encerre o combate antes de iniciar uma nova sessão.');
            const mode = campaignMode(this.state);
            const obligation = modeAllowsObligation(this.state) ? obligation_mjs_1.obligationCheck(this.state.group, character, { rng, roll: obligationRoll }) : { roll: null, total: 0, triggered: false, doubles: false, selected: null, groupPenalty: 0, characterPenalty: 0, progressionBlocked: false, entries: [] };
            const duty = modeAllowsDuty(this.state) ? duty_mjs_1.dutyCheck(this.state.group, character, { rng, roll: dutyRoll }) : { roll: null, total: 0, triggered: false, doubles: false, selected: null, groupWoundThresholdBonus: 0, characterWoundThresholdBonus: 0, entries: [] };
            const destinyPool = destiny_mjs_1.prepareDestinyPool(destinyPlayerCount ?? playerCount, { rng });
            const group = destiny_mjs_1.setPreparedDestiny(this.state.group, destinyPool);
            const obligationApplied = obligation_mjs_1.applyObligationPenalty(character, obligation);
            character = obligationApplied.character;
            const dutyApplied = duty_mjs_1.applyDutyBonus(character, duty);
            character = dutyApplied.character;
            this.commit('GROUP_UPDATED', { group });
            this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character });
            const at = new Date().toISOString();
            let session = sessionFlow_mjs_1.startSessionRuntime(this.state.session, { at });
            const obligationSession = { ...structuredClone(obligation), priorThreshold: obligationApplied.priorThreshold, appliedThreshold: obligationApplied.appliedThreshold };
            const dutySession = { ...structuredClone(duty), baseThreshold: dutyApplied.baseThreshold, effectiveThreshold: dutyApplied.effectiveThreshold };
            session = { ...session, campaignRules: { mode, destiny: structuredClone(destinyPool), obligation: obligationSession, duty: dutySession }, eoteRules: { destiny: structuredClone(destinyPool), obligation: obligationSession } };
            const sessionId = this.state.session?.status === 'encerrada' ? ids_mjs_1.newId('sess') : this.state.sessionId;
            this.commit('SESSION_STARTED', { session, sessionId, scene: { title: session.number === 1 ? 'Abertura' : `Sessão ${session.number}`, narration: this.state.settings?.masterProvider === 'http' ? 'O Mestre está pronto para conduzir a sessão.' : 'A campanha começa agora. O mundo está em movimento, e você decide qual fio puxar primeiro.' } });
            return { session: this.state.session, character, destiny: destinyPool, obligation, duty, campaignMode: mode };
        }
        _setSessionPhase(phase) {
            if (this.state.session?.status !== 'ativa')
                return this.state.session;
            const session = sessionFlow_mjs_1.setSessionPhase(this.state.session, phase);
            this.commit('SESSION_PHASE', { session });
            return session;
        }
        closeSession({ summary = null, xpAward = 0 } = {}) {
            if (this.state.combat?.active)
                throw new Error('Encerre o combate antes de encerrar a sessão.');
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            if (this.state.session?.status !== 'ativa')
                throw new Error('Não há sessão ativa para encerrar.');
            let nextCharacter = obligation_mjs_1.restoreObligationPenalty(character, this.state.session?.campaignRules?.obligation ?? this.state.session?.eoteRules?.obligation);
            nextCharacter = duty_mjs_1.restoreDutyBonus(nextCharacter);
            if (Number(xpAward) > 0)
                nextCharacter = progression_mjs_1.grantExperience(nextCharacter, Number(xpAward), { reason: 'Experiência concedida no encerramento da sessão' }).character;
            const text = String(summary ?? '').trim() || sessionFlow_mjs_1.buildDeterministicSessionSummary({ ...this.state, player: { ...this.state.player, character: nextCharacter } });
            const session = sessionFlow_mjs_1.closeSessionRuntime(this.state.session, { summary: text, xpAwarded: Number(xpAward) || 0 });
            const historyEntry = { sessionId: this.state.sessionId, number: session.number, startedAt: session.startedAt, endedAt: session.endedAt, summary: session.summary, xpAwarded: session.xpAwarded, checksResolved: session.checksResolved, combatEncounters: session.combatEncounters };
            this.commit('SESSION_CLOSED', { session, historyEntry, character: nextCharacter });
            return { session, historyEntry, character: nextCharacter };
        }
        grantXp(amount, { reason = 'Experiência concedida pelo Mestre' } = {}) {

        submitIntent(text) {

            });

        prepareMasterContext(intentText) {
            const prepared = localMaster_mjs_1.prepareLocalMasterTurn(this.state, intentText);
            this.lastMasterContext = prepared.context;
            return prepared;
        }
        applyMasterProposal(rawProposal) {
            const before = structuredClone(this.state);
            try {
                const knownRuleIds = this.lastMasterContext?.rules?.map(r => r.id) ?? this.state.master.lastContext?.ruleIds ?? [];
                const proposal = proposal_mjs_1.validateMasterProposal(rawProposal, { knownRuleIds, pendingAcquisition: this.state.master?.pendingAcquisition });
                let next = proposal_mjs_1.applyValidatedNarrativeProposal(this.state, proposal);
                if (proposal.worldOperations?.length) {
                    const worldResult = applyMasterWorldOperations(next.world, proposal.worldOperations);
                    next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('worldmaster'), type: 'WORLD_UPDATED', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { world: worldResult.world } });
                }
                if (proposal.sceneLocationId) {
                    if (!next.world?.locations?.[proposal.sceneLocationId])
                        throw new Error(`Local da cena não encontrado: ${proposal.sceneLocationId}`);
                    next.scene.locationId = proposal.sceneLocationId;
                }
                next = sceneLibrary_mjs_1.applyAutomaticSceneVisual(next).state;
                validateEncounterDirectiveAgainstState(next, proposal.encounterDirective);
                next = applyEconomicProposal(next, proposal);
                this.state = next;
                this.repository.save(this.state);
                if (this.state.session?.status === 'ativa')
                    this._setSessionPhase(sessionFlow_mjs_1.phaseAfterMasterProposal(proposal));
                return proposal;
            }
            catch (error) {
                this.state = before;
                throw error;
            }
        }
        getOfflineMasterStatus(intentText = '') {
            const prepared = localMaster_mjs_1.prepareLocalMasterTurn(this.state, intentText || 'estado atual');
            return provider_mjs_1.offlineMasterStatus(prepared.context);
        }
        configureTts({ enabled = false, rate = 1 } = {}) {
            const n = Number(rate);
            if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n < 0.6 || n > 1.4)
                throw new Error('Velocidade de TTS inválida.');
            const next = structuredClone(this.state);
            next.settings = next.settings ?? {};
            next.settings.ttsEnabled = Boolean(enabled);
            next.settings.ttsRate = n;
            this.state = next;
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return structuredClone(this.state.settings);
        }
        configureMasterProvider({ mode = 'none', endpoint = null } = {}) {
            if (!['none', 'http'].includes(mode))
                throw new Error('Modo do Mestre inválido.');
            const next = structuredClone(this.state);
            next.settings = next.settings ?? {};
            next.settings.masterProvider = mode;
            next.settings.masterEndpoint = mode === 'http' ? String(endpoint ?? '').trim() || null : null;
            if (mode === 'http' && !next.settings.masterEndpoint)
                throw new Error('Informe o endpoint HTTPS do Mestre.');
            this.state = next;
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return structuredClone(this.state.settings);
        }
        async requestMasterTurn({ intentText, endpoint, fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 15000, signal = null } = {}) {
            if (!String(intentText ?? '').trim())
                throw new Error('Digite uma ação.');
            const before = structuredClone(this.state);
            const prepared = localMaster_mjs_1.prepareLocalMasterTurn(before, intentText.trim());
            try {
                const remote = await provider_mjs_1.requestHttpMasterProposal({ endpoint, context: prepared.context, fetchImpl, timeoutMs, signal });
                const knownRuleIds = prepared.context.rules.map(r => r.id);
                const proposal = proposal_mjs_1.validateMasterProposal(remote.proposal, { knownRuleIds, pendingAcquisition: before.master?.pendingAcquisition });
                let next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(before, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('act'), type: 'PLAYER_INTENT', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { text: intentText.trim() } });
                next = proposal_mjs_1.applyValidatedNarrativeProposal(next, proposal);
                if (proposal.worldOperations?.length) {
                    const worldResult = applyMasterWorldOperations(next.world, proposal.worldOperations);
                    next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('worldmaster'), type: 'WORLD_UPDATED', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { world: worldResult.world } });
                }
                if (proposal.sceneLocationId) {
                    if (!next.world?.locations?.[proposal.sceneLocationId])
                        throw new Error(`Local da cena não encontrado: ${proposal.sceneLocationId}`);
                    next.scene.locationId = proposal.sceneLocationId;
                }
                next = sceneLibrary_mjs_1.applyAutomaticSceneVisual(next).state;
                validateEncounterDirectiveAgainstState(next, proposal.encounterDirective);
                next = applyEconomicProposal(next, proposal);
                next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('master'), type: 'MASTER_RESPONSE_ACCEPTED', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { provider: 'http', sourceRuleIds: proposal.sourceRuleIds } });
                if (next.session?.status === 'ativa')
                    next = events_mjs_1.applyEvent(next, { id: ids_mjs_1.newId('phase'), type: 'SESSION_PHASE', at: new Date().toISOString(), payload: { session: sessionFlow_mjs_1.setSessionPhase(next.session, sessionFlow_mjs_1.phaseAfterMasterProposal(proposal)) } });
                this.state = next;
                this.repository.save(this.state);
                this.lastMasterContext = prepared.context;
                return { proposal, context: prepared.context, meta: remote.meta };
            }
            catch (error) {
                this.state = before;
                throw error;
            }
        }

        initializeLivingSandbox({ startingPoint = 'Porto de Fronteira', regionLabel = 'Região de Fronteira', startMapPoint = null } = {}) {

            }

        }

        startSandboxSession({ rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            // R54_BARBARA_OPENING_MASTER: bootstrap sandbox/session only; Barbara owns first narration.
            if (!this.state.player?.character)
                throw new Error('Crie, gere ou importe um personagem antes de iniciar o sandbox.');
            const opening = sandbox_mjs_1.sandboxOpening(this.state.world, { locationId: this.state.scene?.locationId ?? this.state.world?.sandbox?.startLocationId ?? null, limit: 6 });
            if (!opening?.ready || !opening.location)
                throw new Error('Crie o mundo vivo e escolha o ponto inicial antes de iniciar o sandbox.');
            let session = this.state.session;
            if (session?.status !== 'ativa') {
                const started = this.startSession({ playerCount: 1, rng });
                session = started.session;
            }
            this.commit('SCENE_UPDATED', { scene: { visibleNpcIds: [] } });
            const previousOpening = this.state.master?.openingRequest ?? null;
            const pick = (items, { knownFirst = false, previousId = null } = {}) => {
                let pool = (items ?? []).filter(Boolean);
                if (knownFirst) {
                    const known = pool.filter(item => item?.knownToPlayer);
                    if (known.length)
                        pool = known;
                }
                if (pool.length > 1 && previousId) {
                    const alternatives = pool.filter(item => item?.id !== previousId);
                    if (alternatives.length)
                        pool = alternatives;
                }
                if (!pool.length)
                    return null;
                const roll = Number(rng());
                const unit = Number.isFinite(roll) ? Math.abs(roll % 1) : 0;
                return pool[Math.min(pool.length - 1, Math.floor(unit * pool.length))] ?? pool[0];
            };
            const knownOpportunity = pick(opening.opportunities, { knownFirst: true, previousId: previousOpening?.opportunityId ?? null });
            const knownNpc = pick(opening.npcs, { knownFirst: true, previousId: previousOpening?.npcId ?? null });
            const knownFaction = pick(opening.factions, { knownFirst: true, previousId: previousOpening?.factionId ?? null });
            const openingAngles = ['movimento imediato no local', 'mudança ambiental que exige atenção', 'interação social já em andamento', 'oportunidade percebida durante a chegada', 'contratempo cotidiano com consequências', 'detalhe sensorial que evolui para uma escolha'];
            let anglePool = openingAngles;
            if (openingAngles.length > 1 && previousOpening?.openingAngle)
                anglePool = openingAngles.filter(value => value !== previousOpening.openingAngle);
            const angleRoll = Number(rng());
            const angleUnit = Number.isFinite(angleRoll) ? Math.abs(angleRoll % 1) : 0;
            const openingAngle = anglePool[Math.min(anglePool.length - 1, Math.floor(angleUnit * anglePool.length))] ?? openingAngles[0];
            const locationName = String(opening.location.name ?? this.state.scene?.title ?? 'Ponto inicial');
            const suggestions = [];
            if (knownOpportunity?.title)
                suggestions.push(`Investigar: ${knownOpportunity.title}`);
            if (knownNpc?.name)
                suggestions.push(`Conversar com ${knownNpc.name}`);
            suggestions.push('Observar o local antes de agir');
            if (opening.market)
                suggestions.push('Consultar o mercado local');
            suggestions.push('Procurar rumores e oportunidades');
            suggestions.push('Ignorar a situação e seguir adiante');
            this.commit('MASTER_OPENING_PREPARED', { suggestedActions: suggestions.slice(0, 6), request: { locationName, opportunity: knownOpportunity?.title ?? null, opportunityId: knownOpportunity?.id ?? null, npc: knownNpc?.name ?? null, npcId: knownNpc?.id ?? null, faction: knownFaction?.name ?? null, factionId: knownFaction?.id ?? null, openingAngle } });
            return {
                opening,
                proposal: null,
                awaitingMaster: true,
                masterOpeningRequest: {
                    kind: 'sandbox_opening',
                    locationName,
                    sceneLocationId: opening.location.id,
                    opportunity: knownOpportunity ? { id: knownOpportunity.id ?? null, title: knownOpportunity.title ?? '', summary: knownOpportunity.summary ?? '' } : null,
                    npc: knownNpc ? { id: knownNpc.id ?? null, name: knownNpc.name ?? '', species: knownNpc.species ?? '', sex: knownNpc.sex ?? '', gender: knownNpc.gender ?? '', origin: knownNpc.origin ?? '', career: knownNpc.career ?? '', specialization: knownNpc.specialization ?? '', occupation: knownNpc.occupation ?? '', ageYears: knownNpc.ageYears ?? null, appearance: knownNpc.appearance ?? '' } : null,
                    faction: knownFaction ? { id: knownFaction.id ?? null, name: knownFaction.name ?? '' } : null,
                    openingAngle,
                    suggestedActions: suggestions.slice(0, 6)
                },
                session: structuredClone(session),
                state: structuredClone(this.state)
            };
        }
        publishedAdventureCatalog() {
            return [{ id: underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.id, title: underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.title, originalTitle: underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.originalTitle, rulesProfile: underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.rulesProfile, campaignModes: [...underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.campaignModes] }];
        }

            if (String(adventureId) !== underBlackSun_mjs_1.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.id)
