        return {
            duty: duty - cost,
            xpBonus: (xp5 ? 5 : 0) + (xp10 ? 10 : 0),
            creditBonus: (credits1000 ? 1000 : 0) + (credits2500 ? 2500 : 0),
            dutySpent: cost
        };
    }
    function characteristicUpgradeCost(base, target) {
        const a = int(base, 'Característica base', { min: 1, max: 5 });
        const b = int(target, 'Característica final', { min: a, max: 5 });
        let cost = 0;
        for (let rating = a + 1; rating <= b; rating++)
            cost += rating * 10;
        return cost;
    }
    function totalCharacteristicUpgradeCost(speciesKey, targets = {}) {
        const species = exports.AOR_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Espécie inválida.');
        return Object.entries(species.characteristics).reduce((sum, [key, base]) => sum + characteristicUpgradeCost(base, targets[key] ?? base), 0);
    }
    function requireSelectedSkills(selected, allowed, count, label) {
        const unique = uniq(selected);
        if (unique.length !== count)
            throw new Error(`${label}: escolha exatamente ${count} perícias.`);
        if (unique.some(key => !allowed.includes(key)))
            throw new Error(`${label}: há uma perícia fora da lista permitida.`);
        return unique;
    }
    function addFreeRank(character, skill) {
        if (!(skill in character.skills))
            throw new Error(`Perícia não reconhecida: ${skill}.`);
        if (character.skills[skill] >= 2)
            throw new Error('Nenhuma perícia pode ultrapassar grau 2 durante a criação.');
        character.skills[skill] += 1;
    }
    function validateSpeciesChoice({ speciesKey, choiceSkills = [], careerSkills = [] }) {
        const species = exports.AOR_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Espécie inválida.');
        if (!species.speciesChoice)
            return [];
        if (species.speciesChoice.type === 'oneSkill')
            return requireSelectedSkills(choiceSkills, species.speciesChoice.skills, 1, 'Escolha da espécie');
        if (species.speciesChoice.type === 'twoNonCareer') {
            const choices = uniq(choiceSkills);
            if (choices.length !== 2)
                throw new Error('Humano: escolha exatamente 2 perícias não profissionais diferentes.');
            if (choices.some(skill => !(skill in character_mjs_1.SKILLS)))
                throw new Error('Humano: perícia inválida.');
            if (choices.some(skill => careerSkills.includes(skill)))
                throw new Error('Humano: as duas perícias escolhidas devem ser não profissionais.');
            return choices;
        }
        return [];
    }
    function createAorCoreCharacter(options = {}) {
        const name = String(options.name ?? '').trim();
        if (!name)
            throw new Error('Nome do personagem é obrigatório.');
        const species = exports.AOR_SPECIES[options.speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma espécie válida.');
        const career = exports.AOR_CAREERS[options.careerKey];
        if (!career)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma carreira válida.');
        const specialization = career.specializations?.[options.specializationKey];
        if (!specialization)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma especialização da carreira selecionada.');
        const careerFreeCount = species.careerFreeCount ?? 4;
        const specFreeCount = species.specFreeCount ?? 2;
        const careerFree = requireSelectedSkills(options.careerFreeSkills, career.skills, careerFreeCount, 'Perícias gratuitas da carreira');
        const specFree = requireSelectedSkills(options.specializationFreeSkills, specialization.skills, specFreeCount, 'Perícias gratuitas da especialização');
        const allCareer = uniq([...career.skills, ...specialization.skills]);
        const speciesChoice = validateSpeciesChoice({ speciesKey: options.speciesKey, choiceSkills: options.speciesChoiceSkills, careerSkills: allCareer });
        const party = startingDutyForPartySize(options.partySize ?? 1, { soloPolicy: options.soloStartingDuty ?? exports.SOLO_STARTING_DUTY_LOCAL_POLICY });
        const dutyStart = options.startingDuty === undefined ? party.value : int(options.startingDuty, 'Duty inicial', { min: 0, max: 100 });
        const duty = applyDutyReductions(dutyStart, options.dutyReductions ?? {});
        const xpBudget = species.xp + duty.xpBonus;
        const targets = { ...species.characteristics, ...(options.characteristics ?? {}) };
        const characteristicCost = totalCharacteristicUpgradeCost(options.speciesKey, targets);
        if (characteristicCost > xpBudget)
            throw new Error(`PE insuficientes para as Características: custo ${characteristicCost}, orçamento ${xpBudget}.`);
        const motivation = String(options.motivation ?? '').trim();
        if (!motivation)
            throw new Error('Motivação é obrigatória na criação.');
        const dutyType = String(options.dutyType ?? exports.DUTY_TYPES_PT_BR[0]).trim();
        if (!exports.DUTY_TYPES_PT_BR.includes(dutyType))
            throw new Error('Tipo de Duty inválido para o perfil AoR Core.');
        const c = (0, character_mjs_1.createBlankCharacter)(name);
        c.source = { type: 'custom_aor_core', title: 'Star Wars - Age of Rebellion - Core Rulebook', language: 'en', verifiedSections: ['Character Creation', 'Species', 'Careers', 'Duty', 'Experience', 'Derived Attributes'], notes: party.official ? null : party.note };
        c.species = species.label;
        c.profession = career.label;
        c.specializations = [specialization.label];
        c.characteristics = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(species.characteristics).map(([key, base]) => [key, int(targets[key] ?? base, `Característica ${key}`, { min: base, max: 5 })]));
        c.careerSkills = allCareer;
        for (const skill of careerFree)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        for (const skill of specFree)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        if (species.freeSkill)
            addFreeRank(c, species.freeSkill.skill);
        for (const skill of speciesChoice)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        c.talents = [...(species.freeTalents ?? [])];
        c.derived.soak = c.characteristics.fortaleza + (species.soakBonus ?? 0);
        c.derived.wounds.threshold = species.woundBase + c.characteristics.fortaleza;
        c.derived.strain.threshold = species.strainBase + c.characteristics.voluntad;
        c.xp = { total: xpBudget, available: xpBudget - characteristicCost };
        c.credits = 500 + duty.creditBonus;
        c.duties = [{ type: dutyType, value: duty.duty, startingValue: dutyStart, officialStartingValue: party.official, dutySpent: duty.dutySpent }];
        c.motivations = [{ text: motivation }];
        c.description = { background: String(options.background ?? '').trim(), speciesAbilities: [...(species.abilities ?? [])] };
        c.creation = { rulesProfile: 'AOR_CORE', speciesKey: options.speciesKey, careerKey: options.careerKey, specializationKey: options.specializationKey, careerFreeSkills: careerFree, specializationFreeSkills: specFree, speciesChoiceSkills: speciesChoice, startingXp: species.xp, dutyXpBonus: duty.xpBonus, characteristicXpSpent: characteristicCost, startingCredits: 500 + duty.creditBonus, partySize: Number(options.partySize ?? 1), soloDutyPolicy: party.official ? null : party.value };
        return c;
    }
    function creationPreview(options = {}) {
        const species = exports.AOR_SPECIES[options.speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            return null;
        const party = startingDutyForPartySize(options.partySize ?? 1, { soloPolicy: options.soloStartingDuty ?? exports.SOLO_STARTING_DUTY_LOCAL_POLICY });
        const duty = applyDutyReductions(options.startingDuty === undefined ? party.value : Number(options.startingDuty), options.dutyReductions ?? {});
        const characteristicCost = totalCharacteristicUpgradeCost(options.speciesKey, { ...species.characteristics, ...(options.characteristics ?? {}) });
        const xpBudget = species.xp + duty.xpBonus;
        return { xpBudget, characteristicCost, xpRemaining: xpBudget - characteristicCost, credits: 500 + duty.creditBonus, duty: duty.duty, dutySpent: duty.dutySpent, dutyOfficial: party.official, dutyNote: party.note ?? null };
    }
    function randomUnit(rng) {
        if (typeof rng !== 'function')
            throw new Error('Gerador aleatório inválido.');
        const value = Number(rng());
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value >= 1)
            throw new Error('O gerador aleatório deve retornar valor entre 0 (inclusive) e 1 (exclusive).');
        return value;
    }
    function randomPick(values, rng) {
        if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0)
            throw new Error('Catálogo aleatório vazio.');
        return values[Math.floor(randomUnit(rng) * values.length)];
    }
    function randomSample(values, count, rng) {
        const pool = uniq(values);
        const n = int(count, 'Quantidade aleatória', { min: 0, max: pool.length });
        const result = [];
        while (result.length < n) {
            const index = Math.floor(randomUnit(rng) * pool.length);
            result.push(pool.splice(index, 1)[0]);
        }
        return result;
    }
    function createRandomAorCoreCharacter(options = {}) {
        const name = String(options.name ?? '').trim();
        if (!name)
            throw new Error('Nome do personagem é obrigatório; o gerador não inventa nomes.');
        const motivation = String(options.motivation ?? '').trim();
        if (!motivation)
            throw new Error('Motivação é obrigatória; o gerador não inventa motivações.');
        const rng = options.rng ?? Math.random;
        const speciesKey = randomPick(Object.keys(exports.AOR_SPECIES), rng);
        const careerKey = randomPick(Object.keys(exports.AOR_CAREERS), rng);
        const species = exports.AOR_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        const career = exports.AOR_CAREERS[careerKey];
        const specializationKey = randomPick(Object.keys(career.specializations), rng);
        const specialization = career.specializations[specializationKey];
        const allCareer = uniq([...career.skills, ...specialization.skills]);
        let speciesChoiceSkills = [];
        const protectedSpeciesRanks = [];
        if (species.freeSkill?.skill)
            protectedSpeciesRanks.push(species.freeSkill.skill);
        if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'oneSkill') {
            const skill = randomPick(species.speciesChoice.skills, rng);
            speciesChoiceSkills = [skill];
            protectedSpeciesRanks.push(skill);
        }
        else if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'twoNonCareer') {
            const nonCareer = Object.keys(character_mjs_1.SKILLS).filter(skill => !allCareer.includes(skill));
            speciesChoiceSkills = randomSample(nonCareer, 2, rng);
        }
        const careerFreeCount = species.careerFreeCount ?? 4;
        const specFreeCount = species.specFreeCount ?? 2;
        const careerFreeSkills = randomSample(career.skills, careerFreeCount, rng);
        const specPool = specialization.skills.filter(skill => !(protectedSpeciesRanks.includes(skill) && careerFreeSkills.includes(skill)));
        const specializationFreeSkills = randomSample(specPool, specFreeCount, rng);
        const character = createAorCoreCharacter({
            name,
            motivation,
            background: String(options.background ?? '').trim(),
            partySize: options.partySize ?? 1,
            soloStartingDuty: options.soloStartingDuty,
            speciesKey,
            careerKey,
            specializationKey,
            careerFreeSkills,
            specializationFreeSkills,
            speciesChoiceSkills,
            characteristics: { ...species.characteristics },
            dutyType: randomPick(exports.DUTY_TYPES_PT_BR, rng),
            dutyReductions: {},
        });
        character.creation = { ...character.creation, randomizedMechanics: true };
        return character;
    }
    });

            throw new Error('O combate ainda não foi iniciado.');

        next.round += 1;
        next.playerTurn = { actionUsed: false, maneuversUsed: 0, expertSkillTalentUsed: false };

    function spendAction(combat, label = 'Ação') {
        if (!combat?.active)
            return cloneCombat(combat);
        if (combat.playerTurn?.actionUsed)
            throw new Error('A ação deste turno já foi usada.');
        const next = cloneCombat(combat);
        next.playerTurn.actionUsed = true;
        next.log.push({ type: 'ACAO', round: next.round, label });
        return next;
    }
    function spendManeuver(combat, { method = 'normal', label = 'Manobra', forceFirstStrain = false } = {}) {
        if (!combat?.active)
            return { combat: cloneCombat(combat), strainCost: 0 };
        const used = Number(combat.playerTurn?.maneuversUsed ?? 0);
        if (used >= exports.MAX_MANEUVERS_PER_TURN)
            throw new Error('Não é permitido realizar mais de 2 manobras no turno.');
        const next = cloneCombat(combat);
        let strainCost = 0;
        if (used === 0 && forceFirstStrain) {
            if (method !== 'strain')
                throw new Error('Sem manobra gratuita: esta manobra exige sofrer 2 de Tensão.');
            strainCost = exports.EXTRA_MANEUVER_STRAIN_COST;
        }
        else if (used === 1) {
            if (method === 'strain') {
                strainCost = exports.EXTRA_MANEUVER_STRAIN_COST;
            }
            else if (method === 'action') {
                if (next.playerTurn.actionUsed)
                    throw new Error('A ação já foi usada e não pode ser trocada por uma segunda manobra.');
                next.playerTurn.actionUsed = true;
            }
            else {
                throw new Error('A segunda manobra exige sofrer 2 de Tensão ou trocar a ação do turno.');
            }
        }
        next.playerTurn.maneuversUsed = used + 1;
        next.log.push({ type: 'MANOBRA', round: next.round, label, method: used === 0 && !forceFirstStrain ? 'normal' : method });
        return { combat: next, strainCost };
    }

    function criticalCheckModifiers(character, { skillKey = null, characteristicKey = null, consume = false } = {}) {

            return { character, setback: 0, difficultyIncrease: 0, difficultyUpgrades: 0, removeBoost: false, characteristicPenalty: 0, cannotAct: false, cannotVoluntarilySufferStrain: false, maxManeuvers: null, strainPerAction: 0 };

    exports.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR = Object.freeze([
        'Vício', 'Traição', 'Chantagem', 'Recompensa', 'Criminal', 'Dívida', 'Dever assumido', 'Família', 'Favor', 'Juramento', 'Obsessão', 'Responsabilidade'
    ]);
    function uniq(values) { return [...new Set((values ?? []).filter(Boolean))]; }
    function int(value, label, { min = 0, max = 999 } = {}) {
        const n = Number(value);
        if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max)
            throw new Error(`${label} inválido.`);
        return n;
    }
    function requireSelectedSkills(selected, allowed, count, label) {
        const unique = uniq(selected);
        if (unique.length !== count)
            throw new Error(`${label}: escolha exatamente ${count} perícias.`);
        if (unique.some(k => !allowed.includes(k)))
            throw new Error(`${label}: há uma perícia fora da lista permitida.`);
        return unique;
    }
    function addFreeRank(character, skill) {
        if (!(skill in character.skills))
            throw new Error(`Perícia não reconhecida: ${skill}.`);
        if (character.skills[skill] >= 2)
            throw new Error('Nenhuma perícia pode ultrapassar grau 2 durante a criação.');
        character.skills[skill] += 1;
    }
    function startingObligationForPartySize(partySize, { soloPolicy = exports.SOLO_STARTING_OBLIGATION_LOCAL_POLICY } = {}) {
        const n = int(partySize, 'Quantidade de jogadores', { min: 1, max: 99 });
        if (n === 1)
            return { value: int(soloPolicy, 'Obligation solo', { min: 0, max: 100 }), official: false, note: 'Política local do VTT: a tabela oficial de Obligation começa em 2 personagens.' };
        if (n === 2)
            return { value: 20, official: true };
        if (n === 3)
            return { value: 15, official: true };
        if (n === 4 || n === 5)
            return { value: 10, official: true };
        return { value: 5, official: true };
    }
    function applyAdditionalObligation(startingObligation, { xp5 = false, xp10 = false, credits1000 = false, credits2500 = false } = {}) {
        const start = int(startingObligation, 'Obligation inicial', { min: 0, max: 100 });
        if (xp5 && xp10)
            throw new Error('Escolha no máximo um benefício de PE por Obligation adicional.');
        if (credits1000 && credits2500)
            throw new Error('Escolha no máximo um benefício de créditos por Obligation adicional.');
        const added = (xp5 ? 5 : 0) + (xp10 ? 10 : 0) + (credits1000 ? 5 : 0) + (credits2500 ? 10 : 0);
        if (added > start)
            throw new Error('A Obligation adicional não pode exceder a Obligation inicial do personagem.');
        return { obligation: start + added, additionalObligation: added, xpBonus: (xp5 ? 5 : 0) + (xp10 ? 10 : 0), creditBonus: (credits1000 ? 1000 : 0) + (credits2500 ? 2500 : 0) };
    }
    function characteristicUpgradeCost(base, target) {
        const a = int(base, 'Característica base', { min: 1, max: 5 });
        const b = int(target, 'Característica final', { min: a, max: 5 });
        let cost = 0;
        for (let rating = a + 1; rating <= b; rating++)
            cost += rating * 10;
        return cost;
    }
    function totalEoteCharacteristicUpgradeCost(speciesKey, targets = {}) {
        const species = exports.EOTE_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Espécie inválida.');
        return Object.entries(species.characteristics).reduce((sum, [key, base]) => sum + characteristicUpgradeCost(base, targets[key] ?? base), 0);
    }
    function validateEoteSpeciesChoice({ speciesKey, choiceSkills = [], careerSkills = [], speciesVariant = null } = {}) {
        const species = exports.EOTE_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Espécie inválida.');
        if (!species.speciesChoice)
            return { skills: [], variant: null, xpBonus: 0 };
        if (species.speciesChoice.type === 'oneSkill')
            return { skills: requireSelectedSkills(choiceSkills, species.speciesChoice.skills, 1, 'Escolha da espécie'), variant: null, xpBonus: 0 };
        if (species.speciesChoice.type === 'twoNonCareer') {
            const choices = uniq(choiceSkills);
            if (choices.length !== 2)
                throw new Error('Humano: escolha exatamente 2 perícias não profissionais diferentes.');
            if (choices.some(skill => !(skill in character_mjs_1.SKILLS)))
                throw new Error('Humano: perícia inválida.');
            if (choices.some(skill => careerSkills.includes(skill)))
                throw new Error('Humano: as duas perícias escolhidas devem ser não profissionais.');
            return { skills: choices, variant: null, xpBonus: 0 };
        }
        if (species.speciesChoice.type === 'gandRespiration') {
            const variant = String(speciesVariant ?? '').trim();
            if (!species.speciesChoice.variants.includes(variant))
                throw new Error('Gand: escolha se o personagem possui pulmões ou não possui pulmões.');
            return { skills: [], variant, xpBonus: variant === 'lungs' ? 10 : 0 };
        }
        return { skills: [], variant: null, xpBonus: 0 };
    }
    function createEoteCoreCharacter(options = {}) {
        const name = String(options.name ?? '').trim();
        if (!name)
            throw new Error('Nome do personagem é obrigatório.');
        const species = exports.EOTE_SPECIES[options.speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma espécie válida de Edge of the Empire.');
        const career = exports.EOTE_CAREERS[options.careerKey];
        if (!career)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma carreira válida de Edge of the Empire.');
        const specialization = career.specializations?.[options.specializationKey];
        if (!specialization)
            throw new Error('Escolha uma especialização da carreira selecionada.');
        const careerFreeCount = species.careerFreeCount ?? 4;
        const specFreeCount = species.specFreeCount ?? 2;
        const careerFree = requireSelectedSkills(options.careerFreeSkills, career.skills, careerFreeCount, 'Perícias gratuitas da carreira');
        const specFree = requireSelectedSkills(options.specializationFreeSkills, specialization.skills, specFreeCount, 'Perícias gratuitas da especialização');
        const allCareer = uniq([...career.skills, ...specialization.skills]);
        const speciesChoice = validateEoteSpeciesChoice({ speciesKey: options.speciesKey, choiceSkills: options.speciesChoiceSkills, careerSkills: allCareer, speciesVariant: options.speciesVariant });
        const party = startingObligationForPartySize(options.partySize ?? 1, { soloPolicy: options.soloStartingObligation ?? exports.SOLO_STARTING_OBLIGATION_LOCAL_POLICY });
        const obligationStart = options.startingObligation === undefined ? party.value : int(options.startingObligation, 'Obligation inicial', { min: 0, max: 100 });
        const obligation = applyAdditionalObligation(obligationStart, options.obligationBenefits ?? {});
        const xpBudget = species.xp + speciesChoice.xpBonus + obligation.xpBonus;
        const targets = { ...species.characteristics, ...(options.characteristics ?? {}) };
        const characteristicCost = totalEoteCharacteristicUpgradeCost(options.speciesKey, targets);
        if (characteristicCost > xpBudget)
            throw new Error(`PE insuficientes para as Características: custo ${characteristicCost}, orçamento ${xpBudget}.`);
        const motivation = String(options.motivation ?? '').trim();
        if (!motivation)
            throw new Error('Motivação é obrigatória na criação.');
        const obligationType = String(options.obligationType ?? exports.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR[0]).trim();
        if (!exports.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR.includes(obligationType))
            throw new Error('Tipo de Obligation inválido para o perfil EotE Core.');
        const c = character_mjs_1.createBlankCharacter(name);
        c.source = { type: 'custom_eote_core', title: 'Star Wars: Edge of the Empire — Core Rulebook', language: 'en', verifiedSections: ['Character Creation', 'Species', 'Careers and Specializations', 'Obligation', 'Experience', 'Derived Attributes'], notes: party.official ? null : party.note };
        c.species = species.label;
        c.profession = career.label;
        c.specializations = [specialization.label];
        c.characteristics = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(species.characteristics).map(([key, base]) => [key, int(targets[key] ?? base, `Característica ${key}`, { min: base, max: 5 })]));
        c.careerSkills = allCareer;
        for (const skill of careerFree)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        for (const skill of specFree)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        if (species.freeSkill)
            addFreeRank(c, species.freeSkill.skill);
        for (const skill of speciesChoice.skills)
            addFreeRank(c, skill);
        c.talents = [...(species.freeTalents ?? [])];
        c.derived.soak = c.characteristics.fortaleza + (species.soakBonus ?? 0);
        c.derived.wounds.threshold = species.woundBase + c.characteristics.fortaleza;
        c.derived.strain.threshold = species.strainBase + c.characteristics.voluntad;
        c.xp = { total: xpBudget, available: xpBudget - characteristicCost };
        c.credits = 500 + obligation.creditBonus;
        c.obligations = [{ type: obligationType, value: obligation.obligation, startingValue: obligationStart, officialStartingValue: party.official, additionalObligation: obligation.additionalObligation }];
        c.motivations = [{ text: motivation }];
        c.description = { background: String(options.background ?? '').trim(), speciesAbilities: [...(species.abilities ?? [])], speciesVariant: speciesChoice.variant };
        c.creation = { rulesProfile: exports.EOTE_CORE, speciesKey: options.speciesKey, speciesVariant: speciesChoice.variant, careerKey: options.careerKey, specializationKey: options.specializationKey, careerFreeSkills: careerFree, specializationFreeSkills: specFree, speciesChoiceSkills: speciesChoice.skills, startingXp: species.xp, speciesXpBonus: speciesChoice.xpBonus, obligationXpBonus: obligation.xpBonus, characteristicXpSpent: characteristicCost, startingCredits: c.credits, partySize: Number(options.partySize ?? 1), startingObligation: obligationStart, additionalObligation: obligation.additionalObligation, soloObligationPolicy: party.official ? null : party.value };
        return c;
    }
    function eoteCreationPreview(options = {}) {
        const species = exports.EOTE_SPECIES[options.speciesKey];
        if (!species)
            return null;
        const career = exports.EOTE_CAREERS[options.careerKey] ?? null;
        const specialization = career?.specializations?.[options.specializationKey] ?? null;
        const allCareer = career ? uniq([...career.skills, ...(specialization?.skills ?? [])]) : [];
        let speciesChoice = { skills: [], variant: null, xpBonus: 0 };
        if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'gandRespiration' && options.speciesVariant)
            speciesChoice = validateEoteSpeciesChoice({ speciesKey: options.speciesKey, careerSkills: allCareer, speciesVariant: options.speciesVariant });
        const party = startingObligationForPartySize(options.partySize ?? 1, { soloPolicy: options.soloStartingObligation ?? exports.SOLO_STARTING_OBLIGATION_LOCAL_POLICY });
        const obligation = applyAdditionalObligation(options.startingObligation === undefined ? party.value : Number(options.startingObligation), options.obligationBenefits ?? {});
        const characteristicCost = totalEoteCharacteristicUpgradeCost(options.speciesKey, { ...species.characteristics, ...(options.characteristics ?? {}) });
        const xpBudget = species.xp + speciesChoice.xpBonus + obligation.xpBonus;
        return { xpBudget, characteristicCost, xpRemaining: xpBudget - characteristicCost, credits: 500 + obligation.creditBonus, obligation: obligation.obligation, startingObligation: options.startingObligation === undefined ? party.value : Number(options.startingObligation), additionalObligation: obligation.additionalObligation, obligationOfficial: party.official, obligationNote: party.note ?? null, speciesXpBonus: speciesChoice.xpBonus };
    }
    function randomUnit(rng) {
        const value = Number(rng());
        if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0 || value >= 1)
            throw new Error('O gerador aleatório deve retornar valor entre 0 (inclusive) e 1 (exclusive).');
        return value;
    }
    function randomPick(values, rng) {
        if (!Array.isArray(values) || !values.length)
            throw new Error('Catálogo aleatório vazio.');
        return values[Math.floor(randomUnit(rng) * values.length)];
    }
    function randomSample(values, count, rng) {
        const pool = uniq(values);
        const n = int(count, 'Quantidade aleatória', { min: 0, max: pool.length });
        const result = [];
        while (result.length < n) {
            result.push(pool.splice(Math.floor(randomUnit(rng) * pool.length), 1)[0]);
        }
        return result;
    }
    function createRandomEoteCoreCharacter(options = {}) {
        const name = String(options.name ?? '').trim();
        if (!name)
            throw new Error('Nome do personagem é obrigatório; o gerador não inventa nomes.');
        const motivation = String(options.motivation ?? '').trim();
        if (!motivation)
            throw new Error('Motivação é obrigatória; o gerador não inventa motivações.');
        const rng = options.rng ?? Math.random;
        const speciesKey = randomPick(Object.keys(exports.EOTE_SPECIES), rng);
        const careerKey = randomPick(Object.keys(exports.EOTE_CAREERS), rng);
        const species = exports.EOTE_SPECIES[speciesKey];
        const career = exports.EOTE_CAREERS[careerKey];
        const specializationKey = randomPick(Object.keys(career.specializations), rng);
        const specialization = career.specializations[specializationKey];
        const allCareer = uniq([...career.skills, ...specialization.skills]);
        let speciesChoiceSkills = [];
        let speciesVariant = null;
        const protectedSpeciesRanks = [];
        if (species.freeSkill?.skill)
            protectedSpeciesRanks.push(species.freeSkill.skill);
        if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'oneSkill') {
            const skill = randomPick(species.speciesChoice.skills, rng);
            speciesChoiceSkills = [skill];
            protectedSpeciesRanks.push(skill);
        }
        else if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'twoNonCareer')
            speciesChoiceSkills = randomSample(Object.keys(character_mjs_1.SKILLS).filter(skill => !allCareer.includes(skill)), 2, rng);
        else if (species.speciesChoice?.type === 'gandRespiration')
            speciesVariant = randomPick(species.speciesChoice.variants, rng);
        const careerFreeSkills = randomSample(career.skills, species.careerFreeCount ?? 4, rng);
        const specPool = specialization.skills.filter(skill => !(protectedSpeciesRanks.includes(skill) && careerFreeSkills.includes(skill)));
        const specializationFreeSkills = randomSample(specPool, species.specFreeCount ?? 2, rng);
        const character = createEoteCoreCharacter({ name, motivation, background: String(options.background ?? '').trim(), partySize: options.partySize ?? 1, soloStartingObligation: options.soloStartingObligation, speciesKey, speciesVariant, careerKey, specializationKey, careerFreeSkills, specializationFreeSkills, speciesChoiceSkills, characteristics: { ...species.characteristics }, obligationType: randomPick(exports.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR, rng), obligationBenefits: {} });
        character.creation = { ...character.creation, randomizedMechanics: true };
        return character;
    }
    });

            const idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(11, Math.floor((Number.isFinite(raw) ? raw : 0) * 12)));
            const face = forceData_mjs_1.FORCE_DIE_FACES[idx];
            faces.push({ index: idx + 1, ...face });
            light += face.light;
            dark += face.dark;
        }
        return { dice: count, faces, light, dark };
    }
    function resolveForceResources(character, group, roll, { useOppositePoints = 0 } = {}) {
        const nextCharacter = clone(character), nextGroup = clone(group);
        const f = normalizeForceState(nextCharacter);
        nextCharacter.force = f;
        const light = int(roll?.light, 'Pontos luminosos', { min: 0, max: 50 });
        const dark = int(roll?.dark, 'Pontos sombrios', { min: 0, max: 50 });
        const opposite = int(useOppositePoints, 'Pontos opostos usados', { min: 0, max: 50 });
        const native = f.darkSideUser ? dark : light;
        const availableOpposite = f.darkSideUser ? light : dark;
        if (opposite > availableOpposite)
            throw new Error('Não há resultados opostos suficientes para converter.');
        let strain = 0, flipped = false;
        if (opposite > 0) {
            const destiny = nextGroup?.destiny;
            if (!destiny || !Number.isInteger(destiny.light) || !Number.isInteger(destiny.dark))
                throw new Error('Reserva de Destino inválida.');
            if (f.darkSideUser) {
                if (destiny.dark < 1)
                    throw new Error('Sem Ponto de Destino sombrio para converter resultados luminosos.');
                destiny.dark -= 1;
                destiny.light += 1;
            }
            else {
                if (destiny.light < 1)
                    throw new Error('Sem Ponto de Destino luminoso para converter resultados sombrios.');
                destiny.light -= 1;
                destiny.dark += 1;
            }
            strain = opposite;
            if (!nextCharacter.derived?.strain || !Number.isInteger(nextCharacter.derived.strain.current))
                throw new Error('Ficha sem controle de Tensão.');
            nextCharacter.derived.strain.current += strain;
            flipped = true;
        }
        return { character: nextCharacter, group: nextGroup, points: native + opposite, nativePoints: native, oppositePointsUsed: opposite, strain, flippedDestiny: flipped };
    }
    function purchaseForcePower(character, powerKey) {
        if (!isForceSensitive(character))
            throw new Error('É necessário Force Rating 1 ou maior para adquirir um poder da Força.');
        const tree = forceData_mjs_1.FORCE_POWER_TREES[powerKey];
        if (!tree)
            throw new Error('Poder da Força desconhecido.');
        const next = clone(character), f = normalizeForceState(next);
        if (f.powers[powerKey].purchased)
            throw new Error('Este poder da Força já foi adquirido.');
        if (!Number.isInteger(next.xp?.available) || next.xp.available < tree.baseCost)
            throw new Error(`PE insuficientes: são necessários ${tree.baseCost} PE.`);
        next.xp.available -= tree.baseCost;
        f.powers[powerKey].purchased = true;
        next.force = f;
        return { character: next, powerKey, cost: tree.baseCost };
    }
    function upgradeEntry(powerKey, upgradeId) { const tree = forceData_mjs_1.FORCE_POWER_TREES[powerKey]; return { tree, upgrade: tree?.upgrades?.find(u => u.id === upgradeId) ?? null }; }
    function eligibleForceUpgrades(character, powerKey) {
        const f = normalizeForceState(character), tree = forceData_mjs_1.FORCE_POWER_TREES[powerKey];
        if (!tree || !f.powers[powerKey]?.purchased)
            return [];
        const owned = new Set(f.powers[powerKey].upgrades), xp = Number(character?.xp?.available ?? 0);
        return tree.upgrades.map(u => ({ ...clone(u), purchased: owned.has(u.id), unlocked: u.parents.length === 0 || u.parents.some(p => owned.has(p)), available: !owned.has(u.id) && (u.parents.length === 0 || u.parents.some(p => owned.has(p))) && xp >= u.cost }));
    }
    function purchaseForceUpgrade(character, powerKey, upgradeId) {
        const { tree, upgrade } = upgradeEntry(powerKey, upgradeId);
        if (!tree || !upgrade)
            throw new Error('Aprimoramento da Força desconhecido.');
        const next = clone(character), f = normalizeForceState(next);
        if (!f.powers[powerKey]?.purchased)
            throw new Error('Adquira o poder básico antes dos aprimoramentos.');
        const owned = new Set(f.powers[powerKey].upgrades);
        if (owned.has(upgradeId))
            throw new Error('Aprimoramento já adquirido.');
        if (upgrade.parents.length && !upgrade.parents.some(p => owned.has(p)))
            throw new Error('Aprimoramento ainda não está conectado a um aprimoramento adquirido.');
        if (!Number.isInteger(next.xp?.available) || next.xp.available < upgrade.cost)
            throw new Error(`PE insuficientes: são necessários ${upgrade.cost} PE.`);
        next.xp.available -= upgrade.cost;
        f.powers[powerKey].upgrades.push(upgradeId);
        next.force = f;
        return { character: next, powerKey, upgrade: clone(upgrade), cost: upgrade.cost };
    }
    function commitForceDice(character, { count = 1, effectId = 'ongoing' } = {}) {
        const n = int(count, 'Dados da Força comprometidos', { min: 1, max: 10 });
        const next = clone(character), f = normalizeForceState(next);
        if (f.rating - f.committed < n)
            throw new Error('Force Rating disponível insuficiente para comprometer esses dados.');
        const id = String(effectId ?? '').trim();
        if (!id)
            throw new Error('Identificador do efeito contínuo é obrigatório.');
        if (f.ongoing.some(e => e.id === id))
            throw new Error('Este efeito contínuo já está ativo.');
        f.committed += n;
        f.ongoing.push({ id, count: n });
        next.force = f;
        return { character: next, effectId: id, committed: n, available: f.rating - f.committed };
    }
    function releaseForceDice(character, effectId) {
        const id = String(effectId ?? '').trim();
        const next = clone(character), f = normalizeForceState(next);
        const found = f.ongoing.find(e => e.id === id);
        if (!found)
            throw new Error('Efeito contínuo da Força não encontrado.');
        f.ongoing = f.ongoing.filter(e => e.id !== id);
        f.committed = Math.max(0, f.committed - Number(found.count || 0));
        next.force = f;
        return { character: next, effectId: id, released: Number(found.count || 0), available: f.rating - f.committed };
    }

    function applyObligationPenalty(character, result) {
        const next = clone(character);
        if (!next?.derived?.strain)
            throw new Error('Ficha sem limiar de Tensão.');
        const prior = Number(next.derived.strain.threshold);
        const penalty = Math.max(0, Number(result?.characterPenalty ?? result?.playerStrainThresholdPenalty ?? 0));

            next.sessionEffects.obligationStrainThresholdPenalty = penalty;
        else
            delete next.sessionEffects.obligationStrainThresholdPenalty;
        if (!Object.keys(next.sessionEffects).length)
            delete next.sessionEffects;

    }
    function restoreObligationPenalty(character, sessionObligation) {
        const next = clone(character);
        if (!next?.derived?.strain)
            return next;
        // Migração segura de sessões salvas pela implementação anterior, que reduzia o limiar-base.
        const prior = Number(sessionObligation?.priorThreshold), applied = Number(sessionObligation?.appliedThreshold);

        }
        return next;
    }

    function list(character) { return Array.isArray(character?.statusEffects) ? character.statusEffects : []; }
    function uid(type) { return `${type}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`; }
    function normalizeStatusEffects(character) { const next = clone(character); next.statusEffects = list(next).filter(e => e && TYPES.has(e.type) && e.active !== false).map(e => ({ ...e, active: e.active !== false })); return next; }
    function applyStatusEffect(character, { type, source = 'rule', sourceId = null, duration = 'next_turn', rounds = 1, effect = {} } = {}) {
        if (!TYPES.has(type))
            throw new Error('Efeito de estado desconhecido.');
        const next = normalizeStatusEffects(character);
        const existing = next.statusEffects.find(e => e.type === type && e.sourceId === sourceId && e.active !== false);
        const roundsValue = Math.max(1, Number.isInteger(Number(rounds)) ? Number(rounds) : 1);
        if (existing) {
            if (['next_turn', 'rounds'].includes(duration))
                existing.roundsRemaining = Math.max(1, Number(existing.roundsRemaining ?? 0)) + roundsValue;
            existing.duration = duration === 'encounter' ? 'encounter' : existing.duration;
            existing.effect = { ...existing.effect, ...clone(effect) };
            return next;
        }
        next.statusEffects.push({ id: uid(type), type, source: String(source), sourceId: sourceId ? String(sourceId) : null, duration, roundsRemaining: ['next_turn', 'rounds'].includes(duration) ? roundsValue : null, effect: clone(effect), active: true });
        return next;
    }
    function removeStatusEffect(character, { type = null, sourceId = null } = {}) { const next = normalizeStatusEffects(character); next.statusEffects = next.statusEffects.filter(e => !((!type || e.type === type) && (!sourceId || e.sourceId === sourceId))); return next; }
    function statusModifiers(character, { consumeNextCheck = false } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeStatusEffects(character);
        const out = { character: next, cannotAct: false, cannotManeuver: false, setback: 0, difficultyIncrease: 0, boost: 0, fearImmuneSources: [] };
        for (const e of next.statusEffects) {
            if (e.type === 'staggered')
                out.cannotAct = true;
            if (e.type === 'immobilized')
                out.cannotManeuver = true;
            if (e.type === 'disoriented')
                out.setback += 1;
            if (e.type === 'fear_setback')
                out.setback += Number(e.effect?.setback ?? 1);
            if (e.type === 'fear_difficulty')
                out.difficultyIncrease += Number(e.effect?.difficultyIncrease ?? 1);
            if (e.type === 'fear_boost') {
                out.boost += Number(e.effect?.boost ?? 1);
                if (consumeNextCheck)
                    e.active = false;
            }
            if (e.type === 'fear_immunity' && e.sourceId)
                out.fearImmuneSources.push(e.sourceId);
        }
        next.statusEffects = next.statusEffects.filter(e => e.active !== false);
        return out;
    }
    function expireStatusTurn(character) { const next = normalizeStatusEffects(character); for (const e of next.statusEffects) {
        if (['next_turn', 'rounds'].includes(e.duration)) {
            e.roundsRemaining = Math.max(0, Number(e.roundsRemaining ?? 1) - 1);
            if (e.roundsRemaining === 0)
                e.active = false;
        }

    function expireStatusEncounter(character) { const next = normalizeStatusEffects(character); next.statusEffects = next.statusEffects.filter(e => e.duration !== 'encounter' && e.active !== false); return next; }

                details.push({ talent: rule.label, originalName: rule.originalName, effect: 'remove_setback', amount: rank });
            }

            throw new Error('Tensão de Reação rápida inválida.');
        if (spend > rank)
            throw new Error(`Reação rápida permite no máximo ${rank} de Tensão nesta iniciativa.`);
        return { rank, spend, boost: spend };
    }
    function talentPilotedVehicleDefenseBonus(character) {
        return talentRankByOriginal(character, 'DEFDRI');
    }
    function talentPilotedVehicleSilhouette(character, silhouette) {
        const base = Math.max(0, Number(silhouette) || 0);
        return talentRankByOriginal(character, 'TRICK') > 0 ? Math.max(0, base - 1) : base;
    }
    function fullThrottleTalentSpec(character) {
        const base = talentRankByOriginal(character, 'FULLTH');
        const improved = talentRankByOriginal(character, 'FULLTHIMP') > 0;
        const supreme = talentRankByOriginal(character, 'FULLTHSUP') > 0;
        return { available: base > 0, improved, supreme, bonus: supreme ? 2 : base > 0 ? 1 : 0, actionDifficulty: 3, maneuverDifficulty: 2, improvedStrainCost: improved ? 1 : 0 };
    }
    function galacticCartographerTimeMultiplier(character) {
        return talentRankByOriginal(character, 'GALMAP') > 0 ? 0.5 : 1;
    }
    function expertSkillTalentSpec(character, skillKey) {
        const configs = {
            astronavegacion: { originalName: 'MASSTAR', label: 'Navegador mestre' }
        };
        const config = configs[skillKey];
        if (!config)
            return { available: false, skillKey, originalName: null, label: null, strainCost: 0, difficultyReduction: 0, minDifficulty: 1 };
        const rank = talentRankByOriginal(character, config.originalName);
        return { available: rank > 0, rank, skillKey, originalName: config.originalName, label: config.label, strainCost: 2, difficultyReduction: 1, minDifficulty: 1 };
    }
    function quickStrikeBoost(character, { targetActorId = null, actedActorIds = [] } = {}) {
        const rank = talentRankByOriginal(character, 'QUICKST');
        if (rank < 1 || !targetActorId)
            return { rank, boost: 0, applies: false };
        const acted = new Set(Array.isArray(actedActorIds) ? actedActorIds : []);
        const applies = !acted.has(String(targetActorId));
        return { rank, boost: applies ? rank : 0, applies, targetActorId: String(targetActorId) };
    }
    function forceTalentSummary(character) {
        return {
            forceRating: (0, force_mjs_1.forceRating)(character),
            availableForceRating: (0, force_mjs_1.availableForceRating)(character),
            forceSensitive: (0, force_mjs_1.isForceSensitive)(character),
            overwhelmEmotions: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'OVEREMO') > 0,
            intenseFocus: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'INTFOC') > 0,
            senseDanger: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'SENSEDANGER') > 0,
            balance: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'BALANCE') > 0,
            touchOfFate: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'TOUCHFATE') > 0,
            quickDraw: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'QUICKDR') > 0,
            sixthSense: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'SIXTHSENSE') > 0,
            superiorReflexes: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'SUPREF') > 0
        };
    }
    function overwhelmEmotionsModifiers(character, skillKey, { light = 0, dark = 0 } = {}) {
        if (talentRankByOriginal(character, 'OVEREMO') < 1)
            return { available: false, forceDice: 0, success: 0, threat: 0 };
        if (!['carisma', 'coaccion', 'engano'].includes(skillKey))
            return { available: false, forceDice: 0, success: 0, threat: 0 };
        const l = Math.max(0, Number(light) || 0), d = Math.max(0, Number(dark) || 0);
        if (skillKey === 'carisma')
            return { available: true, forceDice: (0, force_mjs_1.forceRating)(character), success: l, threat: Math.floor(d / 2) };
        return { available: true, forceDice: (0, force_mjs_1.forceRating)(character), success: d, threat: Math.floor(l / 2) };
    }
    function intenseFocusOption(character) { return { available: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'INTFOC') > 0, strainCost: 1, abilityUpgrades: 1 }; }
    function senseDangerOption(character) { return { available: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'SENSEDANGER') > 0, setbackRemoved: 2, usesPerSession: 1 }; }
    function touchOfFateOption(character) { return { available: talentRankByOriginal(character, 'TOUCHFATE') > 0, boost: 2, usesPerSession: 1 }; }
    function balanceRecovery(character, { rng = Math.random } = {}) {
        if (talentRankByOriginal(character, 'BALANCE') < 1)
            return { available: false, recovered: 0, roll: null };
        const roll = (0, force_mjs_1.rollForceDice)(character, { rng });
        return { available: true, recovered: roll.light, roll };
    }

    function int(v, label, { min = 0, max = 999 } = {}) { const n = Number(v); if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < min || n > max)
        throw new Error(`${label} inválido.`); return n; }

    function currentDefenseTotal(vehicle) { return FACING_KEYS.reduce((sum, key) => sum + defenseValue(vehicle.defense?.[key]), 0); }
    function criticalEffectActive(hit, currentRound = null) {
        if (!hit || hit.repaired || hit.effectExpired)
            return false;
        if (currentRound === null || hit.effectExpiresAfterRound === null || hit.effectExpiresAfterRound === undefined)
            return true;
        return Number(currentRound) <= Number(hit.effectExpiresAfterRound);
    }
    function vehicleCriticalResult(total) {

    }
    function unrepairedVehicleCriticalCount(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        return vehicle.criticalHits.filter(hit => !hit?.repaired).length;
    }
    function vehicleCriticalModifiers(vehicle, { currentRound = null } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const mods = {
            defenseLoss: { proa: 0, babor: 0, estribor: 0, popa: 0 }, defenseZero: new Set(),
            speedMaxLoss: 0, enginesDown: false, noManeuvers: false, firingSetback: 0,
            hyperspaceDisabled: false, navigationDisabled: false, cannotVoluntarySystemStrain: false,
            armorLoss: 0, thresholdsHalved: false, depressurizing: false, depressurizeRounds: null,
            fireActive: false, destroyed: false, breakingUp: false, breakingUpDestroyAfterRound: null,
            disabledComponents: new Set(vehicle.disabledComponents ?? []), temporaryDisabledComponents: new Set(),
            pilotRecoveryDifficulty: null, crewDisoriented: false
        };
        for (const hit of vehicle.criticalHits) {
            if (!hit || hit.repaired)
                continue;
            if (hit.key === 'vaporized')
                mods.destroyed = true;
            if (hit.key === 'breaking_up') {
                mods.breakingUp = true;
                const at = Number(hit.destroyAfterRound);
                if (Number.isFinite(at))
                    mods.breakingUpDestroyAfterRound = mods.breakingUpDestroyAfterRound === null ? at : Math.min(mods.breakingUpDestroyAfterRound, at);
                if (hit.destroyed)
                    mods.destroyed = true;
            }
            if (!criticalEffectActive(hit, currentRound))
                continue;
            switch (hit.key) {
                case 'jostled':
                    mods.crewDisoriented = true;
                    break;
                case 'losing_power_to_shields':
                    if (!hit.fallbackSystemStrain)
                        mods.defenseLoss[hit.defenseZone ?? 'proa'] += 1;
                    break;
                case 'knocked_off_course':
                    mods.noManeuvers = true;
                    mods.pilotRecoveryDifficulty = Math.max(mods.pilotRecoveryDifficulty ?? 0, Number(hit.pilotRecoveryDifficulty ?? vehicle.speed ?? 0));
                    break;
                case 'tailspin':
                    mods.firingSetback = Math.max(mods.firingSetback, 2);
                    mods.crewDisoriented = true;
                    break;
                case 'component_hit':
                    if (hit.component)
                        mods.temporaryDisabledComponents.add(hit.component);
                    break;
                case 'shields_failing':
                    if (!hit.fallbackSystemStrain)
                        for (const key of FACING_KEYS)
                            mods.defenseLoss[key] += 1;
                    break;
                case 'hyperdrive_nav_failure':
                    mods.hyperspaceDisabled = true;
                    if (!vehicle.hyperdrive)
                        mods.navigationDisabled = true;
                    break;
                case 'power_fluctuations':
                    mods.cannotVoluntarySystemStrain = true;
                    break;
                case 'shields_down':
                    if (!hit.fallbackSystemStrain) {
                        mods.defenseZero.add(hit.defenseZone ?? 'proa');
                        for (const key of FACING_KEYS)
                            if (key !== (hit.defenseZone ?? 'proa'))
                                mods.defenseLoss[key] += 1;
                    }
                    break;
                case 'engine_damaged':
                    mods.speedMaxLoss += 1;
                    break;
                case 'shield_overload':
                    if (hit.armorFallback)
                        mods.armorLoss += 1;
                    else
                        for (const key of FACING_KEYS)
                            mods.defenseZero.add(key);
                    break;
                case 'engines_down':
                    mods.enginesDown = true;
                    mods.noManeuvers = true;
                    break;
                case 'major_system_failure':
                    if (hit.component)
                        mods.disabledComponents.add(hit.component);
                    break;
                case 'major_hull_breach':
                    mods.depressurizing = true;
                    mods.depressurizeRounds = Number(hit.depressurizeRounds ?? vehicle.silhouette);
                    break;
                case 'destabilized':
                    mods.thresholdsHalved = true;
                    break;
                case 'fire':
                    mods.fireActive = true;
                    break;
            }
        }
        return { ...mods, defenseZero: [...mods.defenseZero], disabledComponents: [...mods.disabledComponents], temporaryDisabledComponents: [...mods.temporaryDisabledComponents] };
    }
    function canVoluntarilyInflictVehicleStrain(vehicle) { return !vehicleCriticalModifiers(vehicle).cannotVoluntarySystemStrain; }
    function expireVehicleCriticalRound(vehicle, currentRound) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const round = Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(currentRound) || 0));
        for (const hit of next.criticalHits) {
            if (hit?.repaired)
                continue;
            if (Number.isFinite(Number(hit?.effectExpiresAfterRound)) && round > Number(hit.effectExpiresAfterRound))
                hit.effectExpired = true;
            if (hit?.key === 'breaking_up' && Number.isFinite(Number(hit.destroyAfterRound)) && round > Number(hit.destroyAfterRound))
                hit.destroyed = true;
        }
        return next;
    }
    function clearKnockedOffCourse(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const hit = [...next.criticalHits].reverse().find(x => x?.key === 'knocked_off_course' && !x.repaired && !x.effectExpired);
        if (hit)
            hit.effectExpired = true;
        return next;
    }

    function eoteCoreStarterVehicleProfiles() {
        return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(exports.EOTE_CORE_STARTER_VEHICLE_KEYS.map(key => [key, exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[key]])));
    }
    function eoteCoreVehicleProfiles() {
        return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(exports.EOTE_CORE_CATALOG_VEHICLE_KEYS.map(key => [key, exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[key]])));
    }
    function eoteActiveVehicleProfiles() {
        return Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(exports.EOTE_ACTIVE_CATALOG_VEHICLE_KEYS.map(key => [key, exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[key]])));
    }
    function applyTractorLock(vehicle, { rating = 1, sourceId = 'tractor' } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const r = int(rating, 'Rating de Tractor', { min: 1, max: 5 });
        next.tractorLocks = Array.isArray(next.tractorLocks) ? next.tractorLocks : [];
        next.tractorLocks = next.tractorLocks.filter(lock => lock?.sourceId !== sourceId);
        next.tractorLocks.push({ sourceId: String(sourceId || 'tractor'), rating: r });
        return next;
    }
    function tractorLockDifficulty(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        return Math.max(0, ...(Array.isArray(vehicle.tractorLocks) ? vehicle.tractorLocks : []).map(lock => Number(lock?.rating) || 0));
    }
    function clearTractorLocks(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        next.tractorLocks = [];
        return next;
    }
    function tractorEscapeCheck(vehicle, character, { rng = Math.random, boost = 0, setback = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        if (!character)
            throw new Error('Piloto ausente.');
        const difficulty = tractorLockDifficulty(vehicle);
        if (difficulty <= 0)
            return { skipped: true, reason: 'not_tractored', difficulty: 0, check: null, vehicle: clone(vehicle) };
        const positive = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool)(Number(character.characteristics?.agilidad ?? 0), Number(character.skills?.pilotar_vehiculo_espacial ?? 0));
        const handling = handlingPoolModifier(vehicle);
        const check = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool)({ ...positive, difficulty, challenge: 0, boost: Number(boost) + handling.boost, setback: Number(setback) + handling.setback }, rng);
        return { difficulty, check, vehicle: check.success ? clearTractorLocks(vehicle) : clone(vehicle) };
    }
    function validateVehicle(vehicle) {
        if (!vehicle || typeof vehicle !== 'object')
            throw new Error('Veículo inválido.');
        if (typeof vehicle.id !== 'string' || !vehicle.id)
            throw new Error('Veículo sem identificador.');
        if (typeof vehicle.name !== 'string' || !vehicle.name)
            throw new Error('Veículo sem nome.');
        int(vehicle.silhouette, 'Silhueta', { min: 0, max: 10 });
        int(vehicle.speedMax, 'Velocidade máxima', { min: 0, max: 9 });
        int(vehicle.speed, 'Velocidade atual', { min: 0, max: vehicle.speedMax });
        signedInt(vehicle.handling, 'Manejo', { min: -9, max: 9 });
        int(vehicle.armor, 'Blindagem', { min: 0, max: 99 });
        int(vehicle.hullThreshold, 'Limiar de Danos no casco', { min: 0, max: 999 });
        int(vehicle.hullDamage, 'Danos no casco', { min: 0, max: 999 });
        int(vehicle.systemStrainThreshold, 'Limiar de Tensão de sistemas', { min: 0, max: 999 });
        int(vehicle.systemStrain, 'Tensão de sistemas', { min: 0, max: 999 });
        for (const key of FACING_KEYS)
            int(defenseValue(vehicle.defense?.[key]), `Defesa ${key}`, { min: 0, max: 9 });
        if (!Array.isArray(vehicle.weapons) || !Array.isArray(vehicle.criticalHits) || !Array.isArray(vehicle.disabledComponents))
            throw new Error('Coleções do veículo inválidas.');
        return true;
    }
    function createVehicleFromProfile(profileKey, { id = null, name = null } = {}) {
        const p = exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[profileKey];
        if (!p)
            throw new Error('Perfil de nave/veículo inválido.');
        const v = { ...clone(p), id: id ?? `veh_${profileKey}`, name: name ?? p.name, speed: 0, hullDamage: 0, systemStrain: 0, criticalHits: [], disabledComponents: [], tractorLocks: [], roundEffects: { evasive: false, stayOnTarget: false, enfiladeTargetId: null, controlledFire: false }, lastSystemStrainAt: null };
        validateVehicle(v);
        return v;
    }
    function vehicleStatus(vehicle, { operator = null, currentRound = null } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const mods = vehicleCriticalModifiers(vehicle, { currentRound });
        const baseHullThreshold = Math.max(0, vehicle.hullThreshold);
        const baseSystemThreshold = Math.max(0, vehicle.systemStrainThreshold);
        const hullThreshold = mods.thresholdsHalved ? Math.floor(baseHullThreshold / 2) : baseHullThreshold;
        const systemStrainThreshold = mods.thresholdsHalved ? Math.floor(baseSystemThreshold / 2) : baseSystemThreshold;
        const hullDisabled = vehicle.hullDamage > hullThreshold;
        const systemsShutdown = vehicle.systemStrain > systemStrainThreshold;
        const speedMax = mods.enginesDown ? 0 : Math.max(0, vehicle.speedMax - mods.speedMaxLoss);
        const defense = Object.fromEntries(FACING_KEYS.map(key => {
            if (systemsShutdown || mods.defenseZero.includes(key))
                return [key, 0];
            const base = defenseValue(vehicle.defense?.[key]);
            return [key, Math.max(0, base - Number(mods.defenseLoss[key] ?? 0)) + (operator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentPilotedVehicleDefenseBonus)(operator) : 0)];
        }));
        const destroyed = Boolean(mods.destroyed);
        const tractorDifficulty = tractorLockDifficulty(vehicle);
        return {
            hullDisabled, systemsShutdown, destroyed, breakingUp: mods.breakingUp,
            tractorLocked: tractorDifficulty > 0, tractorDifficulty,
            operational: !hullDisabled && !destroyed,
            effectiveHullThreshold: hullThreshold, effectiveSystemStrainThreshold: systemStrainThreshold,
            effectiveArmor: Math.max(0, vehicle.armor - mods.armorLoss),
            effectiveSpeedMax: systemsShutdown || destroyed ? 0 : speedMax,
            effectiveSpeed: systemsShutdown || destroyed ? 0 : (mods.enginesDown ? vehicle.speed : Math.min(vehicle.speed, speedMax)),
            defense,
            weaponsOnline: !systemsShutdown && !destroyed,
            noManeuvers: mods.noManeuvers,
            firingSetback: mods.firingSetback,
            hyperspaceDisabled: mods.hyperspaceDisabled,
            navigationDisabled: mods.navigationDisabled,
            cannotVoluntarySystemStrain: mods.cannotVoluntarySystemStrain,
            disabledComponents: mods.disabledComponents,
            temporaryDisabledComponents: mods.temporaryDisabledComponents,
            depressurizing: mods.depressurizing,
            depressurizeRounds: mods.depressurizeRounds,
            fireActive: mods.fireActive,
            label: destroyed ? 'Destruído' : hullDisabled ? 'Inutilizado' : systemsShutdown ? 'Sistemas desconectados' : mods.breakingUp ? 'Desintegrando' : 'Operacional'
        };
    }
    function handlingPoolModifier(vehicle) { validateVehicle(vehicle); return vehicle.handling >= 0 ? { boost: vehicle.handling, setback: 0 } : { boost: 0, setback: Math.abs(vehicle.handling) }; }
    function applyVehicleScaleDamage(vehicle, { damage, breach = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const raw = Math.max(0, int(damage, 'Dano', { min: 0, max: 999 }));
        const effectiveArmor = Math.max(0, vehicleStatus(next).effectiveArmor - int(breach, 'Brecha', { min: 0, max: 99 }));
        const suffered = Math.max(0, raw - effectiveArmor);
        next.hullDamage += suffered;
        return { vehicle: next, suffered, effectiveArmor, status: vehicleStatus(next) };
    }
    function applyVehicleSystemStrain(vehicle, amount, { at = new Date().toISOString() } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const n = int(amount, 'Tensão de sistemas', { min: 0, max: 999 });
        next.systemStrain += n;
        if (n > 0)
            next.lastSystemStrainAt = at;
        return { vehicle: next, suffered: n, status: vehicleStatus(next) };
    }
    function recoverVehicleSystemsAfterFullDay(vehicle, { sufferedNewStrain = false } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        if (!sufferedNewStrain)
            next.systemStrain = Math.max(0, next.systemStrain - 1);
        return { vehicle: next, recovered: vehicle.systemStrain - next.systemStrain };
    }
    function planetaryScaleToPersonal(value) { return Number(value) * 10; }
    function personalScaleToPlanetary(value) { return Number(value) / 10; }
    function accelerateOrBrake(vehicle, delta) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const d = Number(delta);
        if (![-1, 1].includes(d))
            throw new Error('Acelerar/Frear altera a Velocidade em exatamente 1.');
        const status = vehicleStatus(vehicle);
        if (status.noManeuvers)
            throw new Error('Um Critical Hit impede manobras da nave/veículo até ser resolvido ou reparado.');
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        next.speed = Math.max(0, Math.min(status.effectiveSpeedMax, next.speed + d));
        return next;
    }
    function punchIt(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        if (vehicle.silhouette < 1 || vehicle.silhouette > 4)
            throw new Error('Pisar a fundo exige Silhueta de 1 a 4.');
        const status = vehicleStatus(vehicle);
        if (status.noManeuvers)
            throw new Error('Um Critical Hit impede manobras da nave/veículo.');
        if (status.cannotVoluntarySystemStrain)
            throw new Error('Power Fluctuations impede sofrer Tensão de sistemas voluntariamente.');
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const strain = Math.max(0, status.effectiveSpeedMax - next.speed);
        next.speed = status.effectiveSpeedMax;
        next.systemStrain += strain;
        return { vehicle: next, strain, status: vehicleStatus(next) };
    }
    function rangeStepsForSpeed(speed) { const s = int(speed, 'Velocidade', { min: 0, max: 9 }); if (s === 0)
        return 0; if (s === 1)
        return 1; if (s <= 4)
        return 2; return 3; }
    function movePlanetaryRange(currentRange, { direction = 'closer', speed = 0 } = {}) {
        let i = rangeIndex(currentRange);
        const steps = rangeStepsForSpeed(speed);
        if (steps === 0)
            throw new Error('Velocidade 0: a nave não pode usar Avançar.');
        const sign = direction === 'closer' ? -1 : direction === 'farther' ? 1 : 0;
        if (!sign)
            throw new Error('Direção de movimento inválida.');
        i = Math.max(0, Math.min(exports.PLANETARY_RANGE_BANDS.length - 1, i + sign * steps));
        return exports.PLANETARY_RANGE_BANDS[i];
    }
    function canUseEvasiveManeuvers(vehicle) { return vehicle.silhouette >= 1 && vehicle.silhouette <= 4 && vehicle.speed >= 3; }
    function canStayOnTarget(vehicle) { return vehicle.silhouette >= 1 && vehicle.silhouette <= 4 && vehicle.speed >= 3; }
    function canEnfilade(vehicle) { return vehicle.silhouette >= 1 && vehicle.silhouette <= 4 && vehicle.speed >= 4; }
    function setEvasiveManeuvers(vehicle, active = true) { validateVehicle(vehicle); if (active && !canUseEvasiveManeuvers(vehicle))
        throw new Error('Manobras evasivas exigem Silhueta 1–4 e Velocidade 3+.'); const next = clone(vehicle); next.roundEffects.evasive = Boolean(active); return next; }
    function setStayOnTarget(vehicle, active = true) { validateVehicle(vehicle); if (active && !canStayOnTarget(vehicle))
        throw new Error('Seguir o objetivo exige Silhueta 1–4 e Velocidade 3+.'); const next = clone(vehicle); next.roundEffects.stayOnTarget = Boolean(active); return next; }
    function stopShort(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const reduced = next.speed;
        next.speed = 0;
        next.systemStrain += reduced;
        return { vehicle: next, systemStrain: reduced, status: vehicleStatus(next) };
    }
    function setControlledFire(vehicle, active = true) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        next.roundEffects = { ...(next.roundEffects ?? {}), controlledFire: Boolean(active) };
        return next;
    }
    function attemptFullThrottle(vehicle, character, { skillKey = 'pilotar_vehiculo_espacial', asManeuver = false, currentRound = 1, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const spec = (0, talents_mjs_1.fullThrottleTalentSpec)(character);
        if (!spec.available)
            throw new Error('O personagem não possui Aceleração máxima.');
        if (asManeuver && !spec.improved)
            throw new Error('Aceleração máxima como manobra exige Aceleração máxima aprimorada.');
        const characteristic = Number(character?.characteristics?.agilidad ?? 0);
        const rank = Number(character?.skills?.[skillKey] ?? 0);
        const positive = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool)(characteristic, rank);
        const difficulty = asManeuver ? spec.maneuverDifficulty : spec.actionDifficulty;
        const check = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool)({ ...positive, difficulty, challenge: 0, boost: 0, setback: 0 }, rng);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const rounds = Math.max(1, Number(character?.characteristics?.astucia ?? 1));
        if (check.success) {
            const baseMax = Number(exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[next.key]?.speedMax ?? next.speedMax);
            next.speedMax = baseMax + spec.bonus;
            next.roundEffects = { ...(next.roundEffects ?? {}), fullThrottle: { bonus: spec.bonus, expiresAfterRound: Number(currentRound) + rounds - 1 } };
        }
        return { vehicle: next, check, difficulty, bonus: check.success ? spec.bonus : 0, durationRounds: check.success ? rounds : 0, personalStrainCost: asManeuver ? spec.improvedStrainCost : 0, spec };
    }
    function expireFullThrottle(vehicle, currentRound) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const effect = next.roundEffects?.fullThrottle;
        if (!effect)
            return { vehicle: next, expired: false };
        if (Number(currentRound) <= Number(effect.expiresAfterRound))
            return { vehicle: next, expired: false };
        const baseMax = Number(exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[next.key]?.speedMax ?? Math.max(0, next.speedMax - Number(effect.bonus || 0)));
        next.speedMax = baseMax;
        next.speed = Math.min(next.speed, next.speedMax);
        delete next.roundEffects.fullThrottle;
        return { vehicle: next, expired: true };
    }
    function gunneryDifficultyBySilhouette(attackerSilhouette, targetSilhouette) {
        const a = int(attackerSilhouette, 'Silhueta atacante', { min: 0, max: 10 }), t = int(targetSilhouette, 'Silhueta alvo', { min: 0, max: 10 });
        const diff = a - t;
        if (Math.abs(diff) <= 1)
            return 2;
        if (diff <= -2)
            return 1;
        if (diff === 2)
            return 3;
        return 4;
    }
    function enfiladeDifficulty(attackerSpeed, targetSpeed) {
        const a = int(attackerSpeed, 'Velocidade atacante', { min: 0, max: 9 }), t = int(targetSpeed, 'Velocidade alvo', { min: 0, max: 9 });
        if (a === t)
            return 2;
        if (a > t)
            return 1;
        if (t - a === 1)
            return 3;
        return 4;
    }
    function pilotingHazardDifficulty(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const half = Math.ceil(vehicle.silhouette / 2);
        return { difficulty: Math.max(vehicle.speed, half), upgrades: Math.min(vehicle.speed, half) };
    }
    function damageSeverity(current, threshold) { if (current > threshold)
        return 4; if (current > threshold / 2)
        return 3; if (current === threshold / 2)
        return 2; return 1; }
    function damageControlDifficulty(vehicle) { validateVehicle(vehicle); return Math.max(damageSeverity(vehicle.systemStrain, vehicle.systemStrainThreshold), damageSeverity(vehicle.hullDamage, vehicle.hullThreshold)); }
    function applyDamageControl(vehicle, { successes = 0, operator = null } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const s = int(successes, 'Êxitos', { min: 0, max: 99 });
        const tuneUp = operator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentRankByOriginal)(operator, 'FINETUN') : 0;
        const efficientRepair = operator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentRankByOriginal)(operator, 'SOLREP') : 0;
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const beforeStrain = next.systemStrain, beforeHull = next.hullDamage;
        next.systemStrain = Math.max(0, next.systemStrain - (s + tuneUp));
        next.hullDamage = Math.max(0, next.hullDamage - (s + efficientRepair));
        return { vehicle: next, systemStrainRecovered: beforeStrain - next.systemStrain, hullRecovered: beforeHull - next.hullDamage, talentBonuses: { systemStrain: tuneUp, hull: efficientRepair } };
    }
    function applyVehicleCritical(vehicle, { roll = null, rng = Math.random, modifier = 0, component = null, defenseZone = 'proa', inAtmosphere = false, currentRound = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        if (!FACING_KEYS.includes(defenseZone))
            throw new Error('Zona de Defesa inválida.');
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const rawRoll = roll === null ? Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(0.999999999999, Number(rng()))) * 100) + 1 : int(roll, 'Rolagem de Critical Hit', { min: 1, max: 100 });
        const existing = unrepairedVehicleCriticalCount(next);
        const externalModifier = Math.trunc(Number(modifier) || 0);
        const total = rawRoll + (existing * 10) + externalModifier;
        let row = vehicleCriticalResult(total);
        if (row.key === 'major_hull_breach' && inAtmosphere)
            row = exports.VEHICLE_CRITICAL_HIT_TABLE.find(x => x.key === 'destabilized');
        const currentStatus = vehicleStatus(next, { currentRound });
        const number = next.criticalHits.length + 1;
        const hit = {
            number, key: row.key, title: row.title, severity: row.severity, repairDifficulty: row.repairDifficulty,
            rawRoll, existingCriticalModifier: existing * 10, externalModifier, total,
            effect: '', repaired: false, effectExpired: false, component: component ?? null, defenseZone,
            source: 'EOTE_CORE_TABLE_7_9'
        };
        let requiresComponentChoice = false;
        switch (row.key) {
            case 'mechanical_stress':
                next.systemStrain += 1;
                hit.effect = 'Sofre imediatamente 1 de Tensão de sistemas.';
                break;
            case 'jostled':
                hit.crewStrain = 1;
                hit.crewDisorientedRounds = 1;
                hit.effect = 'Toda a tripulação sofre 1 de Tensão e fica Desorientada por 1 assalto.';
                break;
            case 'losing_power_to_shields': {
                const noDefense = Object.values(currentStatus.defense).every(v => v <= 0);
                hit.fallbackSystemStrain = noDefense;
                if (noDefense)
                    next.systemStrain += 1;
                hit.effect = noDefense ? 'Sem Defesa ativa: sofre 1 de Tensão de sistemas.' : `Defesa em ${defenseZone} reduzida em 1 até reparo.`;
                break;
            }
            case 'knocked_off_course':

    function repairVehicleCritical(vehicle, index, { encounterEnded = true } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const i = int(index, 'Índice do Critical Hit', { min: 0, max: next.criticalHits.length - 1 });
        const hit = next.criticalHits[i];
        if (!hit)
            throw new Error('Critical Hit inexistente.');
        if (hit.repaired)
            return next;
        if (hit.key === 'vaporized' || hit.destroyed)
            throw new Error('Uma nave vaporizada/destruída não pode ser reparada.');
        if (hit.repairAfterEncounter && !encounterEnded)
            throw new Error('Este Critical Hit só pode ser reparado após o fim do encontro.');
        hit.repaired = true;
        hit.effectExpired = true;
        return next;
    }
    function upgradePositivePool(pool, upgrades = 0) {
        let ability = Math.max(0, Number(pool?.ability ?? 0)), proficiency = Math.max(0, Number(pool?.proficiency ?? 0));
        let n = Math.max(0, Number(upgrades) || 0);
        while (n-- > 0) {
            if (ability > 0) {
                ability -= 1;
                proficiency += 1;
            }
            else
                ability += 1;
        }
        return { ability, proficiency };
    }
    function upgradeDifficultyPool(difficulty, challenge = 0, upgrades = 0) {
        let d = Math.max(0, Number(difficulty) || 0), c = Math.max(0, Number(challenge) || 0), n = Math.max(0, Number(upgrades) || 0);
        while (n-- > 0) {
            if (d > 0) {
                d -= 1;
                c += 1;
            }
            else
                d += 1;
        }
        return { difficulty: d, challenge: c };
    }
    function vehicleAttackPool({ character, attacker, target, targetOperator = null, facing = 'proa', weaponIndex = 0, targetRange = 'Bocajarro', rng = Math.random, extraBoost = 0, extraSetback = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(attacker);
        validateVehicle(target);
        if (!character)
            throw new Error('Atacante sem personagem/operador.');
        const weapon = attacker.weapons?.[weaponIndex];

            throw new Error('Arma de veículo inválida.');

            throw new Error('As armas estão offline por sobrecarga dos sistemas.');
        if (rangeIndex(targetRange) > rangeIndex(weapon.range))
            throw new Error(`Alvo fora do alcance desta arma (${weapon.range}).`);

        const positiveUpgrades = (attacker.roundEffects?.stayOnTarget ? 1 : 0) + (target.roundEffects?.stayOnTarget ? 1 : 0);
